9SYMS_API SYMS_PdbTpiOffRange
10syms_pdb_tpi__hint_from_index(SYMS_PdbTpiAccel *tpi, SYMS_CvTypeIndex ti){
11 // b.s. rule: largest 'index' so that 'tpi->hints[index].ti <= ti'
12 // or, when that's impossible, 'index = tpi->count'
13 SYMS_PdbTpiOffHint *hints = tpi->hints;
14 SYMS_U32 index = tpi->count;
15 SYMS_U32 min = 0;
16 SYMS_U32 max = tpi->count;
17 for (;;){
18 SYMS_U32 mid = (min + max)/2;
19 SYMS_PdbTpiOffHint *h = hints + mid;
20 if (h->ti > ti){
21 max = mid;
22 if (max == 0){
23 break;
24 }
25 }
26 else{
27 min = mid;
28 if (min + 1 >= max){
29 index = min;
30 break;
31 }
32 }
33 }
34
35 // return result
36 SYMS_PdbTpiOffRange result = {0};
37 if (index < tpi->count){
38 result.first_off = tpi->base_off + tpi->hints[index].off;
39 result.first_ti = tpi->hints[index].ti;
40 result.opl_ti = SYMS_U32_MAX;
41 if (index + 1 < tpi->count){
42 result.opl_ti = tpi->hints[index + 1].ti;
43 }
44 }
45 return(result);
46}

48SYMS_API void
49syms_pdb_tpi__fill_off_range(SYMS_String8 data, SYMS_MsfAccel *msf, SYMS_PdbTpiAccel *tpi,
50 SYMS_PdbTpiOffRange *fill){
51 // fill params
52 SYMS_U32 first_off = fill->first_off;
53 SYMS_CvTypeIndex first_ti = SYMS_ClampBot(tpi->first_ti, fill->first_ti);
54 SYMS_CvTypeIndex opl_ti = SYMS_ClampTop(fill->opl_ti, tpi->opl_ti);
55 SYMS_MsfStreamNumber sn = tpi->type_sn;
56
57 // default fill to non-zero invalid off (all bytes 0xFF)
58 // we do this because we use zero to indicate "cache not filled"
59 // so "filled by invalid" needs another value.
60 SYMS_U32 *type_off_ptr = tpi->off + first_ti - tpi->first_ti;
61 syms_memset(type_off_ptr, 0xFF, sizeof(*type_off_ptr)*(opl_ti - first_ti));
62
63 // fill
64 SYMS_U32 cursor = first_off;
65 for (SYMS_CvTypeIndex ti = first_ti;
66 ti < opl_ti;
67 ti += 1, type_off_ptr += 1){
68 // save off
69 *type_off_ptr = cursor;
70 // read size
71 SYMS_U16 size = 0;
72 syms_msf_read_struct(data, msf, sn, cursor, &size);
73 // advance
74 cursor += 2 + size;
75 if (size == 0 || !syms_msf_bounds_check(msf, sn, cursor)){
76 break;
77 }
78 }
79}

81SYMS_API SYMS_PdbTpiAccel
82syms_pdb_tpi_accel_from_sn(SYMS_Arena *arena, SYMS_String8 data, SYMS_MsfAccel *msf, SYMS_MsfStreamNumber sn){
83 SYMS_ProfBegin("syms_pdb_tpi_accel_from_sn");
84
85 // init data structures
86 SYMS_PdbTpiAccel result = {0};
87
88 SYMS_PdbTpiHeader hdr = {0};
89 syms_msf_read_struct(data, msf, sn, 0, &hdr);
90 if (hdr.version == SYMS_PdbTpiVersion_IMPV80){ // NOTE(allen): the only version we support so far.
91
92 // parse hash table
93 SYMS_PdbChain **buckets = 0;
94 SYMS_U32 bucket_count = 0;
95
96 if (hdr.hash_bucket_count != 0){
97 // grab scratch
98 SYMS_ArenaTemp scratch = syms_get_scratch(&arena, 1);
99
100 // setup buckets
101 bucket_count = hdr.hash_bucket_count;
102 buckets = syms_push_array(arena, SYMS_PdbChain*, bucket_count);
103 syms_memset(buckets, 0, sizeof(*buckets)*bucket_count);
104
105 // grab hash array
106 SYMS_MsfRange hash_range = syms_msf_range_from_sn(msf, hdr.hash_sn);
107 SYMS_MsfRange range = syms_msf_sub_range(hash_range, hdr.hash_vals.off, hdr.hash_vals.size);
108 SYMS_String8 hash_array = syms_msf_read_whole_range(scratch.arena, data, msf, range);
109
110 // iterate hash vals
111 SYMS_U32 stride = hdr.hash_key_size;
112 SYMS_U8 *cursor = hash_array.str;
113 SYMS_U8 *opl_cursor = hash_array.str + hash_array.size;
114 SYMS_CvTypeIndex ti = hdr.ti_lo;
115 for (;;){
116 // read index
117 SYMS_U32 bucket_index = 0;
118 syms_memmove(&bucket_index, cursor, stride);
119
120 // save to typemap
121 SYMS_PdbChain *entry = 0;
122 if (bucket_index < bucket_count){
123 entry = syms_push_array(arena, SYMS_PdbChain, 1);
124 syms_memzero_struct(entry);
125 SYMS_StackPush(buckets[bucket_index], entry);
126 entry->v = ti;
127 }
128
129 // advance cursor
130 cursor += stride;
131 ti += 1;
132
133 // exit condition
134 if (cursor >= opl_cursor){
135 break;
136 }
137 }
138
139 // release scratch
140 syms_release_scratch(scratch);
141 }
142
143 // parse hint table
144 SYMS_PdbTpiOffHint *hints = 0;
145 SYMS_U32 hint_count = 0;
146 {
147 SYMS_MsfRange hash_range = syms_msf_range_from_sn(msf, hdr.hash_sn);
148 SYMS_MsfRange range = syms_msf_sub_range(hash_range, hdr.ti_off.off, hdr.ti_off.size);
149 SYMS_String8 hint_memory = syms_msf_read_whole_range(arena, data, msf, range);
150 hints = (SYMS_PdbTpiOffHint*)hint_memory.str;
151 hint_count = (hint_memory.size)/sizeof(*hints);
152 }
153
154 // offset array
155 SYMS_CvTypeIndex first_ti = 0;
156 SYMS_CvTypeIndex opl_ti = 0;
157 SYMS_U32 *off = 0;
158 {
159 first_ti = hdr.ti_lo;
160 opl_ti = SYMS_ClampBot(first_ti, hdr.ti_hi);
161
162 SYMS_U64 count = opl_ti - first_ti;
163 off = syms_push_array_zero(arena, SYMS_U32, count);
164 }
165
166 // fill result
167 result.type_sn = sn;
168 result.buckets = buckets;
169 result.bucket_count = bucket_count;
170 result.count = hint_count;
171 result.hints = hints;
172 result.base_off = hdr.header_size;
173 result.first_ti = first_ti;
174 result.opl_ti = opl_ti;
175 result.off = off;
176 }
177
178 SYMS_ProfEnd();
179
180 return(result);
181}

183SYMS_API SYMS_U32
184syms_pdb_tpi_off_from_ti(SYMS_String8 data, SYMS_MsfAccel *msf, SYMS_PdbTpiAccel *tpi,
185 SYMS_CvTypeIndex ti){
186 SYMS_U32 result = 0;
187 if (tpi->first_ti <= ti && ti < tpi->opl_ti){
188 // read off
189 SYMS_U32 relative_index = ti - tpi->first_ti;
190 SYMS_U32 off = tpi->off[relative_index];
191
192 // if not zero this is the result
193 if (off != 0){
194 result = off;
195 }
196
197 // otherwise compute and cache this off range
198 else{
199 SYMS_PdbTpiOffRange hint = syms_pdb_tpi__hint_from_index(tpi, ti);
200 syms_pdb_tpi__fill_off_range(data, msf, tpi, &hint);
201 result = tpi->off[relative_index];
202 }
203
204 // collapse "error cases" down to null
205 if (result == SYMS_U32_MAX){
206 result = 0;
207 }
208 }
209 return(result);
210}

224SYMS_API SYMS_USIDList
225syms_pdb_types_from_name(SYMS_Arena *arena, SYMS_String8 data, SYMS_PdbDbgAccel *dbg,
226 SYMS_CvUnitAccel *unit, SYMS_String8 name){
227 // setup accel
228 SYMS_PdbTpiAccel *tpi = &dbg->tpi;
229
230 SYMS_USIDList result = {0};
231 if (tpi->bucket_count > 0){
232
233 // get uid
234 SYMS_UnitID uid = unit->uid;
235
236 // get bucket
237 SYMS_U32 name_hash = syms_pdb_hashV1(name);
238 SYMS_U32 bucket_index = name_hash%tpi->bucket_count;
239
240 // iterate bucket
241 for (SYMS_PdbChain *bucket = tpi->buckets[bucket_index];
242 bucket != 0;
243 bucket = bucket->next){
244 SYMS_CvTypeIndex ti = bucket->v;
245 if (unit->top_min_index <= ti){
246 SYMS_U64 index = ti - unit->top_min_index;
247 if (index < unit->ti_count){
248 SYMS_CvStub *stub = unit->ti_indirect_stubs[index];
249 if (stub != 0 && syms_string_match(stub->name, name, 0)){
250 SYMS_USIDNode *usid_node = syms_push_array(arena, SYMS_USIDNode, 1);
251 SYMS_QueuePush(result.first, result.last, usid_node);
252 result.count += 1;
253 usid_node->usid.uid = uid;
254 usid_node->usid.sid = SYMS_ID_u32_u32(SYMS_CvSymbolIDKind_Index, ti);
255 }
256 }
257 }
258 }
259 }
260
261 return(result);
262}

267SYMS_API SYMS_PdbGsiAccel
268syms_pdb_gsi_accel_from_range(SYMS_Arena *arena, SYMS_String8 data, SYMS_MsfAccel *msf, SYMS_MsfRange range){
269 SYMS_ProfBegin("syms_pdb_parse_info");
270
271 // get scratch
272 SYMS_ArenaTemp scratch = syms_get_scratch(&arena, 1);
273 // check gsi info
274 SYMS_B32 has_gsi = syms_false;
275 SYMS_PdbGsiHeader header = {0};
276 if (syms_msf_read_struct_in_range(data, msf, range, 0, &header)){
277 if (header.sig == SYMS_PdbGsiSignature_Basic &&
278 header.ver == SYMS_PdbGsiVersion_V70 &&
279 header.num_buckets != 0){
280 has_gsi = syms_true;
281 }
282 }
283
284 // hash offset
285 SYMS_U32 hash_record_array_off = sizeof(header);
286
287 // bucket count
288 SYMS_U32 bucket_count = 4096;
289 SYMS_U32 slot_count = bucket_count + 1;
290
291 // get unpacked offsets
292 SYMS_U32 *unpacked_offsets = 0;
293 if (has_gsi){
294 unpacked_offsets = syms_push_array(scratch.arena, SYMS_U32, slot_count);
295
296 SYMS_ArenaTemp temp = syms_arena_temp_begin(scratch.arena);
297
298 // array offsets
299 SYMS_U32 bitmask_count = ((slot_count + 31)/32);
300 SYMS_U32 bitmask_size = bitmask_count*4;
301 SYMS_U32 bitmask_off = hash_record_array_off + header.hr_len;
302 SYMS_U32 offsets_off = bitmask_off + bitmask_size;
303
304 // read bitmask
305 SYMS_MsfRange bitmask_range = syms_msf_sub_range(range, bitmask_off, bitmask_size);
306 SYMS_String8 bitmask = syms_msf_read_whole_range(scratch.arena, data, msf, bitmask_range);
307 SYMS_U32 bitmask_count_clamped = bitmask.size/4;
308
309 // read packed offsets
310 SYMS_MsfRange offsets_range = syms_msf_sub_range(range, offsets_off, range.size - offsets_off);
311 SYMS_String8 packed_offsets = syms_msf_read_whole_range(scratch.arena, data, msf, offsets_range);
312 SYMS_U32 packed_offsets_count = packed_offsets.size/4;
313
314 // unpack offsets
315 SYMS_U32 *bitmask_ptr = (SYMS_U32*)(bitmask.str);
316 SYMS_U32 *bitmask_opl = bitmask_ptr + bitmask_count_clamped;
317 SYMS_U32 *dst_ptr = unpacked_offsets;
318 SYMS_U32 *dst_opl = dst_ptr + slot_count;
319 SYMS_U32 *src_ptr = (SYMS_U32*)packed_offsets.str;
320 SYMS_U32 *src_opl = src_ptr + packed_offsets_count;
321 for (; bitmask_ptr < bitmask_opl && src_ptr < src_opl; bitmask_ptr += 1){
322 SYMS_U32 bits = *bitmask_ptr;
323 SYMS_U32 dst_max = (SYMS_U32)(dst_opl - dst_ptr);
324 SYMS_U32 src_max = (SYMS_U32)(src_opl - src_ptr);
325 SYMS_U32 k_max0 = SYMS_ClampTop(32, dst_max);
326 SYMS_U32 k_max = SYMS_ClampTop(k_max0, src_max);
327 for (SYMS_U32 k = 0; k < k_max; k += 1){
328 if ((bits & 1) == 1){
329 *dst_ptr = *src_ptr;
330 src_ptr += 1;
331 }
332 else{
333 *dst_ptr = SYMS_U32_MAX;
334 }
335 dst_ptr += 1;
336 bits >>= 1;
337 }
338 }
339 for (; dst_ptr < dst_opl; dst_ptr += 1){
340 *dst_ptr = SYMS_U32_MAX;
341 }
342
343 syms_arena_temp_end(temp);
344 }
345
346 // construct table
347 SYMS_PdbChain **table = 0;
348 SYMS_B32 table_build_success = syms_true;
349 if (unpacked_offsets != 0){
350 table = syms_push_array(arena, SYMS_PdbChain*, bucket_count + 1);
351
352 // read hash records
353 SYMS_MsfRange hash_record_range = syms_msf_sub_range(range, hash_record_array_off, header.hr_len);
354 SYMS_String8 hash_records = syms_msf_read_whole_range(scratch.arena, data, msf, hash_record_range);
355 SYMS_U32 entry_count = hash_records.size/sizeof(SYMS_PdbGsiHashRecord);
356
357 // build bucket chains
358 // NOTE(allen): we have to do this backwards to make the singly linked
359 // stacks end up in the right order, and because of the way groups of
360 // offsets are stored by PDB (it is specified this way on purpose)
361 SYMS_U32 last_index = entry_count - 1;
362 SYMS_PdbGsiHashRecord *in_ptr = (SYMS_PdbGsiHashRecord*)(hash_records.str) + last_index;
363 SYMS_U32 prev_n = entry_count;
364 for (SYMS_U32 i = bucket_count + 1; i > 0;){
365 i -= 1;
366 SYMS_PdbChain *table_ptr = 0;
367 if (unpacked_offsets[i] != SYMS_U32_MAX){
368 SYMS_U32 n = unpacked_offsets[i]/sizeof(SYMS_PdbGsiHrOffsetCalc);
369 if (n > prev_n){
370 table_build_success = syms_false;
371 break;
372 }
373 SYMS_U32 num_steps = prev_n - n;
374 for (SYMS_U32 j = 0; j < num_steps; j += 1){
375 SYMS_PdbChain *bucket = syms_push_array(arena, SYMS_PdbChain, 1);
376 bucket->next = 0;
377 bucket->v = in_ptr->off - 1;
378 SYMS_StackPush(table_ptr, bucket);
379 in_ptr -= 1;
380 }
381 prev_n = n;
382 }
383 table[i] = table_ptr;
384 }
385 }
386
387 // build the result
388 SYMS_PdbGsiAccel result = {0};
389 if (table_build_success){
390 result.buckets = table;
391 result.bucket_count = bucket_count;
392 }
393
394 // release scratch
395 syms_release_scratch(scratch);
396
397 SYMS_ProfEnd();
398
399 return(result);
400}

402SYMS_API SYMS_MsfRange
403syms_pdb_gsi_part_from_psi_range(SYMS_MsfRange psi_range){

419SYMS_API SYMS_USIDList
420syms_pdb_symbols_from_name(SYMS_Arena *arena, SYMS_String8 data, SYMS_MsfAccel *msf,
421 SYMS_PdbGsiAccel *gsi, SYMS_CvUnitAccel *unit, SYMS_String8 name){
422 SYMS_USIDList result = {0};
423
424 if (gsi->bucket_count > 0){
425 // get unit range
426 SYMS_MsfRange range = syms_msf_range_from_sn(msf, unit->sn);
427
428 // grab scratch
429 SYMS_ArenaTemp scratch = syms_get_scratch(&arena, 1);
430
431 // get bucket
432 SYMS_U32 name_hash = syms_pdb_hashV1(name);
433 SYMS_U32 bucket_index = name_hash%gsi->bucket_count;
434
435 // iterate bucket
436 for (SYMS_PdbChain *bucket = gsi->buckets[bucket_index];
437 bucket != 0;
438 bucket = bucket->next){
439 SYMS_U32 off = bucket->v;
440 SYMS_CvStub *stub = syms_cv_stub_from_unit_off(unit, off);
441 if (stub != 0 && syms_string_match(stub->name, name, 0)){
442 SYMS_CvElement element = syms_cv_element(data, msf, range, stub->off, 1);
443
444 SYMS_UnitID uid = 0;
445 SYMS_SymbolID sid = 0;
446 switch (element.kind){
447 case SYMS_CvSymKind_PROCREF:
448 case SYMS_CvSymKind_LPROCREF:
449 case SYMS_CvSymKind_DATAREF:
450 {
451 SYMS_CvRef2 ref2 = {0};
452 syms_msf_read_struct_in_range(data, msf, element.range, 0, &ref2);
453 uid = SYMS_PdbPseudoUnit_COUNT + ref2.imod;
454 sid = SYMS_ID_u32_u32(SYMS_CvSymbolIDKind_Off, ref2.sym_off);
455 }break;
456 }
457
458 if (uid != 0){
459 SYMS_USIDNode *chain = syms_push_array(arena, SYMS_USIDNode, 1);
460 SYMS_QueuePush(result.first, result.last, chain);
461 result.count += 1;
462 chain->usid.uid = uid;
463 chain->usid.sid = sid;
464 }
465 }
466 }
467
468 // release scratch
469 syms_release_scratch(scratch);
470 }
471
472 return(result);
473}

480SYMS_API SYMS_PdbDbiAccel
481syms_pdb_dbi_from_msf(SYMS_String8 data, SYMS_MsfAccel *msf, SYMS_MsfStreamNumber sn){
482 SYMS_ProfBegin("syms_pdb_dbi_from_msf");
483
484 // grab the dbi stream
485 SYMS_MsfRange range = syms_msf_range_from_sn(msf, sn);
486
487 // read dbi header
488 SYMS_PdbDbiHeader header = {0};
489 syms_msf_read_struct_in_range(data, msf, range, 0, &header);
490
491 // extract dbi info
492 SYMS_PdbDbiAccel result = {0};
493 if (header.sig == SYMS_PdbDbiHeaderSignature_V1){
494 // info directly from the header
495 result.valid = 1;
496 result.machine_type = header.machine;
497 result.gsi_sn = header.gsi_sn;
498 result.psi_sn = header.psi_sn;
499 result.sym_sn = header.sym_sn;
500
501 //- organize the sizes of the ranges in dbi
502 SYMS_U64 range_size[SYMS_PdbDbiRange_COUNT];
503 range_size[SYMS_PdbDbiRange_ModuleInfo] = header.module_info_size;
504 range_size[SYMS_PdbDbiRange_SecCon] = header.sec_con_size;
505 range_size[SYMS_PdbDbiRange_SecMap] = header.sec_map_size;
506 range_size[SYMS_PdbDbiRange_FileInfo] = header.file_info_size;
507 range_size[SYMS_PdbDbiRange_TSM] = header.tsm_size;
508 range_size[SYMS_PdbDbiRange_EcInfo] = header.ec_info_size;
509 range_size[SYMS_PdbDbiRange_DbgHeader] = header.dbg_header_size;
510
511 //- fill range offset array
512 {
513 SYMS_U64 cursor = sizeof(header);
514 SYMS_U64 i = 0;
515 for (; i < (SYMS_U64)(SYMS_PdbDbiRange_COUNT); i += 1){
516 result.range_off[i] = cursor;
517 cursor += range_size[i];
518 cursor = SYMS_ClampTop(cursor, range.size);
519 }
520 // allen: one last value past the end so that off[i + 1] - off[i] can get us the sizes back.
521 result.range_off[i] = cursor;
522 }
523
524 //- read debug streams
525 {
526 // allen: zero is a valid stream [ it sucks I know :( ]
527 // so we explicitly invalidate sn by clearing to 0xFF instead.
528 syms_memset(result.dbg_sn, 0xFF, sizeof(result.dbg_sn));
529 SYMS_MsfRange dbg_sub_range = syms_pdb_dbi_sub_range(&result, sn, SYMS_PdbDbiRange_DbgHeader);
530 SYMS_U64 read_size = SYMS_ClampTop(sizeof(result.dbg_sn), dbg_sub_range.size);
531 syms_msf_read_in_range(data, msf, dbg_sub_range, 0, read_size, result.dbg_sn);
532 }
533 }
534
535 SYMS_ProfEnd();
536
537 return(result);
538}

555SYMS_API SYMS_PdbInfoTable
556syms_pdb_parse_info(SYMS_Arena *arena, SYMS_String8 data, SYMS_MsfAccel *msf){
557 SYMS_ProfBegin("syms_pdb_parse_info");
558
559 // grab the info stream
560 SYMS_MsfRange range = syms_msf_range_from_sn(msf, SYMS_PdbFixedStream_PDB);
561
562 // read info stream's header
563 SYMS_PdbInfoHeader header = {0};
564 syms_msf_read_struct_in_range(data, msf, range, 0, &header);
565 SYMS_U32 after_header_off = sizeof(header);
566
567 // read auth_guid (only in certain recent pdb versions)
568 SYMS_PeGuid auth_guid = {0};
569 SYMS_U32 after_auth_guid_off = after_header_off;
570 switch (header.version){
571 case SYMS_PdbVersion_VC70_DEP:
572 case SYMS_PdbVersion_VC70:
573 case SYMS_PdbVersion_VC80:
574 case SYMS_PdbVersion_VC110:
575 case SYMS_PdbVersion_VC140:
576 {
577 syms_msf_read_struct_in_range(data, msf, range, after_header_off, &auth_guid);
578 after_auth_guid_off = after_header_off + sizeof(auth_guid);
579 }break;
580
581 default:
582 {}break;
583 }
584
585 // read table layout data
586 SYMS_U32 names_base_off = 0;
587 SYMS_U32 hash_table_count = 0;
588 SYMS_U32 hash_table_max = 0;
589 SYMS_U32 epilogue_base_off = 0;
590
591 if (header.version != 0){
592 SYMS_U32 names_len_off = after_auth_guid_off;
593
594 SYMS_U32 names_len = 0;
595 syms_msf_read_struct_in_range(data, msf, range, names_len_off, &names_len);
596
597 names_base_off = names_len_off + 4;
598
599 SYMS_U32 hash_table_count_off = names_base_off + names_len;
600 syms_msf_read_struct_in_range(data, msf, range, hash_table_count_off, &hash_table_count);
601
602 SYMS_U32 hash_table_max_off = hash_table_count_off + 4;
603 syms_msf_read_struct_in_range(data, msf, range, hash_table_max_off, &hash_table_max);
604
605 SYMS_U32 num_present_words_off = hash_table_max_off + 4;
606 SYMS_U32 num_present_words = 0;
607 syms_msf_read_struct_in_range(data, msf, range, num_present_words_off, &num_present_words);
608
609 SYMS_U32 present_words_array_off = num_present_words_off + 4;
610
611 SYMS_U32 num_deleted_words_off = present_words_array_off + num_present_words*sizeof(SYMS_U32);
612 SYMS_U32 num_deleted_words = 0;
613 syms_msf_read_struct_in_range(data, msf, range, num_deleted_words_off, &num_deleted_words);
614
615 SYMS_U32 deleted_words_array_off = num_deleted_words_off + 4;
616
617 epilogue_base_off = deleted_words_array_off + num_deleted_words*sizeof(SYMS_U32);
618 }
619
620 // read table
621 SYMS_PdbInfoTable result = {0};
622 if (hash_table_count > 0 && syms_msf_bounds_check_in_range(range, epilogue_base_off)){
623 SYMS_U32 record_off = epilogue_base_off;
624 for (SYMS_U32 i = 0;
625 i < hash_table_count;
626 i += 1, record_off += 8){
627 // read record
628 SYMS_U32 record[2];
629 syms_msf_read_in_range(data, msf, range, record_off, 8, record);
630 SYMS_U32 relative_name_off = record[0];
631 SYMS_MsfStreamNumber sn = (SYMS_MsfStreamNumber)record[1];
632
633 // read name
634 SYMS_U32 name_off = names_base_off + relative_name_off;
635 SYMS_String8 name = syms_msf_read_zstring_in_range(arena, data, msf, range, name_off);
636
637 // push new slot
638 SYMS_PdbInfoSlot *slot = syms_push_array(arena, SYMS_PdbInfoSlot, 1);
639 SYMS_QueuePush(result.first, result.last, slot);
640 slot->string = name;
641 slot->sn = sn;
642 }
643 }
644 result.auth_guid = auth_guid;
645
646 SYMS_ProfEnd();
647
648 return(result);
649}
650
651SYMS_API SYMS_PdbNamedStreamArray
652syms_pdb_named_stream_array(SYMS_PdbInfoTable *table){
653 SYMS_ProfBegin("syms_pdb_named_stream_array");
654
655 // mapping "PdbDbiNamedStream" indexes to strings
656 struct StreamNameIndexPair{
657 SYMS_PdbNamedStream index;
658 SYMS_String8 name;
659 };
660 struct StreamNameIndexPair pairs[] = {
661 {SYMS_PdbNamedStream_HEADER_BLOCK, syms_str8_lit("/src/headerblock")},
662 {SYMS_PdbNamedStream_STRTABLE , syms_str8_lit("/names")},
663 {SYMS_PdbNamedStream_LINK_INFO , syms_str8_lit("/LinkInfo")},
664 };
665
666 // build baked array of stream indices
667 SYMS_PdbNamedStreamArray result = {0};
668 struct StreamNameIndexPair *p = pairs;
669 for (SYMS_U64 i = 0; i < SYMS_ARRAY_SIZE(pairs); i += 1, p += 1){
670 SYMS_String8 name = p->name;
671 // slot from name
672 SYMS_PdbInfoSlot *matching_slot = 0;
673 for (SYMS_PdbInfoSlot *slot = table->first;
674 slot != 0;
675 slot = slot->next){
676 if (syms_string_match(name, slot->string, 0)){
677 matching_slot = slot;
678 break;
679 }
680 }
681 // store this slot's stream number into the array
682 if (matching_slot != 0){
683 result.sn[p->index] = matching_slot->sn;
684 }
685 }
686
687 SYMS_ProfEnd();
688
689 return(result);
690}
691
692SYMS_API SYMS_PdbStrtblAccel
693syms_pdb_dbi_parse_strtbl(SYMS_Arena *arena, SYMS_String8 data, SYMS_MsfAccel *msf, SYMS_MsfStreamNumber sn){
694 SYMS_ProfBegin("syms_pdb_dbi_parse_strtbl");
695
696 // grab the strtable stream
697 SYMS_MsfRange range = syms_msf_range_from_sn(msf, sn);
698
699 // read strtable's header
700 SYMS_PdbDbiStrTableHeader header = {0};
701 syms_msf_read_struct_in_range(data, msf, range, 0, &header);
702
703 // read strtable's layout
704 SYMS_PdbStrtblAccel result = {0};
705 if (header.magic == SYMS_PdbDbiStrTableHeader_MAGIC && header.version == 1){
706 SYMS_U32 strblock_size_off = sizeof(header);
707 SYMS_U32 strblock_size = 0;
708 syms_msf_read_struct_in_range(data, msf, range, strblock_size_off, &strblock_size);
709 SYMS_U32 strblock_off = strblock_size_off + 4;
710
711 SYMS_U32 bucket_count_off = strblock_off + strblock_size;
712 SYMS_U32 bucket_count = 0;
713 syms_msf_read_struct_in_range(data, msf, range, bucket_count_off, &bucket_count);
714
715 SYMS_U32 bucket_array_off = bucket_count_off + 4;
716 SYMS_U32 bucket_array_size = bucket_count*sizeof(SYMS_PdbStringIndex);
717
718 if (syms_msf_bounds_check_in_range(range, bucket_array_off + bucket_array_size)){
719 result.bucket_count = bucket_count;
720 result.sn = sn;
721 result.strblock.min = range.off + strblock_off;
722 result.strblock.max = result.strblock.min + strblock_size;
723 result.buckets.min = range.off + bucket_array_off;
724 result.buckets.max = result.buckets.min + bucket_array_size;
725 }
726 }
727
728 SYMS_ProfEnd();
729
730 return(result);
731}

736SYMS_API SYMS_String8
737syms_pdb_strtbl_string_from_off(SYMS_Arena *arena, SYMS_String8 data, SYMS_PdbDbgAccel *dbg, SYMS_U32 off){
738 // setup accel
739 SYMS_MsfAccel *msf = dbg->msf;
740 SYMS_PdbStrtblAccel *strtbl = &dbg->strtbl;
741
742 // get string range
743 SYMS_MsfRange range = syms_msf_range_from_sn(msf, strtbl->sn);
744 SYMS_MsfRange str_range = syms_msf_sub_range_from_off_range(range, strtbl->strblock);
745
746 // read string
747 SYMS_String8 result = syms_msf_read_zstring_in_range(arena, data, msf, str_range, off);
748 return(result);
749}

751SYMS_API SYMS_String8
752syms_pdb_strtbl_string_from_index(SYMS_Arena *arena, SYMS_String8 data, SYMS_PdbDbgAccel *dbg,
753 SYMS_PdbStringIndex n){
754 // setup accel
755 SYMS_MsfAccel *msf = dbg->msf;
756 SYMS_PdbStrtblAccel *strtbl = &dbg->strtbl;
757
758 SYMS_String8 result = {0};
759 if (n < strtbl->bucket_count){
760 // get bucket range
761 SYMS_MsfRange range = syms_msf_range_from_sn(msf, strtbl->sn);
762 SYMS_MsfRange bkt_range = syms_msf_sub_range_from_off_range(range, strtbl->buckets);
763
764 // get offset
765 SYMS_U32 offset_off = n*4;
766 SYMS_U32 offset = 0;
767 if (syms_msf_read_struct_in_range(data, msf, bkt_range, offset_off, &offset)){
768
769 // get string range
770 SYMS_MsfRange str_range = syms_msf_sub_range_from_off_range(range, strtbl->strblock);
771
772 // read string
773 result = syms_msf_read_zstring_in_range(arena, data, msf, str_range, offset);
774 }
775 }
776
777 return(result);
778}

795SYMS_API SYMS_PdbDbgAccel*
796syms_pdb_dbg_accel_from_file(SYMS_Arena *arena, SYMS_String8 data, SYMS_PdbFileAccel *file){
797 // setup accel
798 SYMS_MsfAccel *msf = file->msf;
799
800 // setup result
801 SYMS_PdbDbgAccel *result = (SYMS_PdbDbgAccel*)&syms_format_nil;
802
803 // parse dbi header
804 SYMS_PdbDbiAccel dbi = syms_pdb_dbi_from_msf(data, msf, SYMS_PdbFixedStream_DBI);
805 if (dbi.valid){
806 // copy msf if it's not a prior on this arena.
807 // TODO(allen): re-apply deep copy optimizations using handle checks
808 SYMS_MsfAccel *dbg_msf = syms_msf_deep_copy(arena, msf);
809
810 // parse info table
811 SYMS_ArenaTemp scratch = syms_get_scratch(&arena, 1);
812 SYMS_PdbInfoTable info_table = syms_pdb_parse_info(scratch.arena, data, msf);
813
814 // get gsi range
815 SYMS_MsfRange gsi_range = syms_msf_range_from_sn(msf, dbi.gsi_sn);
816 SYMS_MsfRange psi_range = syms_msf_range_from_sn(msf, dbi.psi_sn);
817 SYMS_MsfRange gsi_part_psi_range = syms_pdb_gsi_part_from_psi_range(psi_range);
818
819 // get an msf range for section data
820 SYMS_MsfRange section_data_range = syms_pdb_dbi_stream(msf, &dbi, SYMS_PdbDbiStream_SECTION_HEADER);
821
822 // setup voff acceleration for coff sections
823 SYMS_U64Array section_voff_array = {0};
824 {
825 // grab coff array
826 SYMS_U64 sec_count = section_data_range.size/sizeof(SYMS_CoffSectionHeader);
827 SYMS_CoffSectionHeader *sec_hdrs = syms_push_array(scratch.arena, SYMS_CoffSectionHeader, sec_count);
828 syms_msf_read_in_range(data, msf, section_data_range, 0, sec_count*sizeof(*sec_hdrs), sec_hdrs);
829
830 // convert to voff array
831 section_voff_array = syms_pecoff_voff_array_from_coff_hdr_array(arena, sec_hdrs, sec_count);
832 }
833
834 // fill accelerator
835 {
836 result = syms_push_array(arena, SYMS_PdbDbgAccel, 1);
837 result->format = SYMS_FileFormat_PDB;
838
839 // msf
840 result->msf = dbg_msf;
841
842 // pdb
843 result->dbi = dbi;
844 result->named = syms_pdb_named_stream_array(&info_table);
845 result->strtbl = syms_pdb_dbi_parse_strtbl(arena, data, msf, result->named.sn[SYMS_PdbNamedStream_STRTABLE]);
846 result->tpi = syms_pdb_tpi_accel_from_sn(arena, data, msf, SYMS_PdbFixedStream_TPI);
847 result->ipi = syms_pdb_tpi_accel_from_sn(arena, data, msf, SYMS_PdbFixedStream_IPI);
848 result->gsi = syms_pdb_gsi_accel_from_range(arena, data, msf, gsi_range);
849 result->psi = syms_pdb_gsi_accel_from_range(arena, data, msf, gsi_part_psi_range);
850 result->auth_guid = info_table.auth_guid;
851
852 // arch
853 result->arch = syms_arch_from_coff_machine_type(dbi.machine_type);
854
855 // type uid
856 result->type_uid = SYMS_PdbPseudoUnit_TPI;
857
858 // section data
859 result->section_data_range = section_data_range;
860 result->section_voffs = section_voff_array.u64;
861 result->section_count = section_voff_array.count;
862 }
863
864 // release scratch
865 syms_release_scratch(scratch);
866 }
867 return(result);
868}

954// main api
955
956SYMS_API SYMS_PdbUnitSetAccel*
957syms_pdb_unit_set_accel_from_dbg(SYMS_Arena *arena, SYMS_String8 data, SYMS_PdbDbgAccel *dbg){
958 // setup accels
959 SYMS_MsfAccel *msf = dbg->msf;
960 SYMS_PdbDbiAccel *dbi = &dbg->dbi;
961
962 // parse list of modules
963 SYMS_PdbCompUnitNode *first = 0;
964 SYMS_PdbCompUnitNode *last = 0;
965 SYMS_U64 count = 0;
966
967 {
968 // grab module info range
969 SYMS_MsfRange range = syms_pdb_dbi_sub_range(dbi, SYMS_PdbFixedStream_DBI, SYMS_PdbDbiRange_ModuleInfo);
970
971 // parse loop
972 SYMS_U64 off = 0;
973 for (;;){
974 // exit condition - past end
975 if (off >= range.size){
976 break;
977 }
978
979 // extract comp unit info
980 SYMS_B32 got_comp_unit = syms_false;
981 SYMS_PdbCompUnit comp_unit = {0};
982 SYMS_U32 next_comp_unit_off = 0;
983
984 SYMS_PdbDbiCompUnitHeader header = {0};
985 if (syms_msf_read_struct_in_range(data, msf, range, off, &header)){
986 got_comp_unit = syms_true;
987
988 // extract names from after header
989 SYMS_U32 name_off = off + sizeof(header);
990 SYMS_String8 name = syms_msf_read_zstring_in_range(arena, data, msf, range, name_off);
991
992 SYMS_U32 name2_off = name_off + name.size + 1;
993 SYMS_String8 name2 = syms_msf_read_zstring_in_range(arena, data, msf, range, name2_off);
994
995 SYMS_U32 after_name2_off = name2_off + name2.size + 1;
996 next_comp_unit_off = (after_name2_off + 3)&~3;
997
998 // get the size of this mod's stream
999 SYMS_MsfStreamInfo stream_info = syms_msf_stream_info_from_sn(msf, header.sn);
1000 SYMS_U64 stream_size = stream_info.size;
1001
1002 // organize size information
1003 SYMS_U64 range_size[SYMS_PdbCompUnitRange_COUNT];
1004 range_size[SYMS_PdbCompUnitRange_Symbols] = header.symbol_bytes;
1005 range_size[SYMS_PdbCompUnitRange_C11] = header.c11_lines_size;
1006 range_size[SYMS_PdbCompUnitRange_C13] = header.c13_lines_size;
1007
1008 // fill comp unit range offs
1009 {
1010 SYMS_U64 cursor = 0;
1011 SYMS_U64 i = 0;
1012 for (; i < (SYMS_U64)(SYMS_PdbCompUnitRange_COUNT); i += 1){
1013 comp_unit.range_off[i] = cursor;
1014 cursor += range_size[i];
1015 cursor = SYMS_ClampTop(cursor, stream_size);
1016 }
1017 //~ allen: one last value past the end so that off[i + 1] - off[i] can get us the sizes back.
1018 comp_unit.range_off[i] = cursor;
1019 }
1020
1021 // skip annoying signature in first range
1022 if (range_size[SYMS_PdbCompUnitRange_Symbols] > 4){
1023 comp_unit.range_off[0] += 4;
1024 }
1025
1026 // fill comp unit direct fields
1027 comp_unit.sn = header.sn;
1028 comp_unit.src_file = header.src_file;
1029 comp_unit.pdb_file = header.pdb_file;
1030
1031 comp_unit.group_name = name;
1032 comp_unit.obj_name = name2;
1033 }
1034
1035 // exit condition - failed read
1036 if (!got_comp_unit){
1037 break;
1038 }
1039
1040 // save to list
1041 SYMS_PdbCompUnitNode *node = syms_push_array(arena, SYMS_PdbCompUnitNode, 1);
1042 SYMS_QueuePush(first, last, node);
1043 count += 1;
1044 syms_memmove(&node->comp_unit, &comp_unit, sizeof(comp_unit));
1045
1046 // increment offset
1047 off = next_comp_unit_off;
1048 }
1049 }
1050
1051 // linearize for quick index
1052 SYMS_PdbCompUnit **comp_units = syms_push_array(arena, SYMS_PdbCompUnit*, count);
1053 {
1054 SYMS_PdbCompUnit **comp_unit_ptr = comp_units;
1055 for (SYMS_PdbCompUnitNode *node = first;
1056 node != 0;
1057 node = node->next, comp_unit_ptr += 1){
1058 *comp_unit_ptr = &node->comp_unit;
1059 }
1060 }
1061
1062 // fill result
1063 SYMS_PdbUnitSetAccel *result = syms_push_array(arena, SYMS_PdbUnitSetAccel, 1);
1064 result->format = SYMS_FileFormat_PDB;
1065 result->comp_units = comp_units;
1066 result->comp_count = count;
1067
1068 return(result);
1069}
1070
1071SYMS_API SYMS_U64
1072syms_pdb_unit_count_from_set(SYMS_PdbUnitSetAccel *unit_set){
1073 SYMS_U64 result = unit_set->comp_count + SYMS_PdbPseudoUnit_COUNT;
1074 return(result);

1077SYMS_API SYMS_UnitInfo
1078syms_pdb_unit_info_from_uid(SYMS_PdbUnitSetAccel *unit_set, SYMS_UnitID uid){
1079 SYMS_UnitInfo result = {0};
1080
1081 // TODO(allen): language
1082
1083 switch (uid){
1084 case SYMS_PdbPseudoUnit_SYM:
1085 {
1086 result.features = (SYMS_UnitFeature_StaticVariables|
1087 SYMS_UnitFeature_ExternVariables|
1088 SYMS_UnitFeature_FunctionStubs);
1089 }break;
1090
1091 case SYMS_PdbPseudoUnit_TPI:
1092 {
1093 result.features = SYMS_UnitFeature_Types;
1094 }break;
1095
1096 default:
1097 {
1098 SYMS_PdbCompUnit *unit = syms_pdb_comp_unit_from_id(unit_set, uid);
1099 if (unit != 0){
1100 result.features = (SYMS_UnitFeature_CompilationUnit|
1101 SYMS_UnitFeature_StaticVariables|
1102 SYMS_UnitFeature_Functions);
1103 }
1104 }break;
1105 }
1106
1107 return(result);
1108}

1121
1122SYMS_API SYMS_UnitRangeArray
1123syms_pdb_unit_ranges_from_set(SYMS_Arena *arena, SYMS_String8 data, SYMS_PdbDbgAccel *dbg,
1124 SYMS_PdbUnitSetAccel *unit_set){
1125 SYMS_ArenaTemp scratch = syms_get_scratch(&arena, 1);
1126
1127 //- setup accels
1128 SYMS_MsfAccel *msf = dbg->msf;
1129 SYMS_PdbDbiAccel *dbi = &dbg->dbi;
1130
1131 //- parse contributions
1132 SYMS_U64 range_count = 0;
1133 SYMS_UnitRange *ranges = 0;
1134 {
1135 // grab module info range
1136 SYMS_MsfRange range = syms_pdb_dbi_sub_range(dbi, SYMS_PdbFixedStream_DBI, SYMS_PdbDbiRange_SecCon);
1137
1138 // read version
1139 SYMS_PdbDbiSectionContribVersion version = 0;
1140 syms_msf_read_struct_in_range(data, msf, range, 0, &version);
1141
1142 // read array off/size info
1143 SYMS_U32 item_size = 0;
1144 SYMS_U32 array_off = 0;
1145 switch (version){
1146 default:
1147 {
1148 // TODO(allen): do we have a test case for this?
1149 version = 0;
1150 item_size = sizeof(SYMS_PdbDbiSectionContrib40);
1151 }break;
1152 case SYMS_PdbDbiSectionContribVersion_1:
1153 {
1154 item_size = sizeof(SYMS_PdbDbiSectionContrib);
1155 array_off = sizeof(version);
1156 }break;
1157 case SYMS_PdbDbiSectionContribVersion_2:
1158 {
1159 item_size = sizeof(SYMS_PdbDbiSectionContrib2);
1160 array_off = sizeof(version);
1161 }break;
1162 }
1163
1164 // allocate ranges array
1165 SYMS_U64 max_count = (range.size - array_off)/item_size;
1166 ranges = syms_push_array(arena, SYMS_UnitRange, max_count);
1167
1168 // read contribution data
1169 SYMS_MsfRange sub_range = syms_msf_sub_range(range, array_off, range.size - array_off);
1170 SYMS_String8 contrib_data = syms_msf_read_whole_range(scratch.arena, data, msf, sub_range);
1171
1172 // grab section -> voff accel
1173 SYMS_U64 section_count = dbg->section_count;
1174 SYMS_U64 *section_voffs = dbg->section_voffs;
1175
1176 // fill array
1177 {
1178 SYMS_UnitRange *unit_range = ranges;
1179 SYMS_UnitRange *opl = ranges + max_count;
1180 SYMS_U8 *ptr = contrib_data.str;
1181 SYMS_U8 *ptr_opl = contrib_data.str + contrib_data.size;
1182 for (; ptr < ptr_opl; ptr += item_size){
1183 SYMS_PdbDbiSectionContrib40 *sc = (SYMS_PdbDbiSectionContrib40*)ptr;
1184 if (sc->size > 0 && 1 <= sc->sec && sc->sec <= section_count){
1185 // calculate range
1186 SYMS_U64 section_voff = section_voffs[sc->sec - 1];
1187 SYMS_U64 min = section_voff + sc->sec_off;
1188
1189 // fill unit range
1190 unit_range->vrange.min = min;
1191 unit_range->vrange.max = min + sc->size;
1192 unit_range->uid = sc->mod + SYMS_PdbPseudoUnit_FIRST_COMP_UNIT;
1193 unit_range += 1;
1194 }
1195 }
1196
1197 range_count = (SYMS_U64)(unit_range - ranges);
1198
1199 syms_arena_put_back(arena, sizeof(SYMS_UnitRange)*(max_count - range_count));
1200 }
1201 }
1202
1203 syms_release_scratch(scratch);
1204
1205 //- assemble result
1206 SYMS_UnitRangeArray result = {ranges, range_count};
1207 return(result);
1208}

1285 params.format = SYMS_FileFormat_PDB;

1287 params.align = SYMS_CV_SYMBOL_ALIGN_IN_PDB;
1288
1289 result = syms_cv_sym_unit_from_ranges(arena, data, dbg->msf, range.sn, range_array, &params);

1291 }break;
1292 }
1293
1294 return(result);

1343SYMS_API SYMS_TypeInfo
1344syms_pdb_type_info_from_sid(SYMS_String8 data, SYMS_PdbDbgAccel *dbg, SYMS_CvUnitAccel *unit,
1345 SYMS_SymbolID sid){
1346 SYMS_TypeInfo result = {SYMS_TypeKind_Null};
1347 if (unit->leaf_set){
1348 // setup
1349 SYMS_MsfAccel *msf = dbg->msf;
1350 SYMS_UnitID uid = unit->uid;
1351
1352 // get type info
1353 result = syms_cv_type_info_from_sid(data, msf, unit, sid);
1354
1355 // ipi information lookup
1356 if (SYMS_ID_u32_0(sid) == SYMS_CvSymbolIDKind_Index){
1357 SYMS_CvTypeIndex ti = SYMS_ID_u32_1(sid);
1358
1359 SYMS_PdbTpiAccel *ipi = &dbg->ipi;
1360 SYMS_MsfRange ipi_range = syms_msf_range_from_sn(msf, ipi->type_sn);
1361
1362 if (ipi->bucket_count > 0){
1363
1364 // get bucket
1365 SYMS_String8 id_data = {(SYMS_U8*)&ti, sizeof(ti)};
1366 SYMS_U32 ti_hash = syms_pdb_hashV1(id_data);
1367 SYMS_U32 bucket_index = ti_hash%ipi->bucket_count;
1368
1369 // iterate bucket
1370 for (SYMS_PdbChain *bucket = ipi->buckets[bucket_index];
1371 bucket != 0;
1372 bucket = bucket->next){
1373 SYMS_CvItemId item_id = bucket->v;
1374 SYMS_U32 item_off = syms_pdb_tpi_off_from_ti(data, msf, ipi, item_id);
1375
1376 SYMS_CvElement element = syms_cv_element(data, msf, ipi_range, item_off, 1);
1377 switch (element.kind){
1378 default:break;
1379
1380 case SYMS_CvLeaf_UDT_MOD_SRC_LINE:
1381 {
1382 // TODO(allen): we have never hit this case before; we're not sure how it works,
1383 // and have no way to test it.
1384 SYMS_ASSERT_PARANOID(!"not implemented");
1385#if 0
1386 SYMS_CvLeafModSrcLine mod_src_line = {0};
1387 if (syms_msf_read_struct_in_range(data, msf, element.range, 0, &mod_src_line)){
1388 }
1389#endif
1390 }break;
1391
1392 case SYMS_CvLeaf_UDT_SRC_LINE:
1393 {
1394 SYMS_CvLeafUDTSrcLine udt_src_line = {0};
1395 if (syms_msf_read_struct_in_range(data, msf, element.range, 0, &udt_src_line)){
1396 if (udt_src_line.udt_itype == ti){
1397 result.src_coord.file_id = SYMS_ID_u32_u32(SYMS_CvFileIDKind_IPIStringID, udt_src_line.src);
1398 result.src_coord.line = udt_src_line.ln;
1399 goto dbl_break;
1400 }
1401 }
1402 }break;
1403 }
1404 }
1405
1406 dbl_break:;
1407 }
1408 }
1409
1410 }
1411 return(result);
1412}

1427SYMS_API SYMS_USID
1428syms_pdb_sym_type_from_var_id(SYMS_String8 data, SYMS_PdbDbgAccel *dbg, SYMS_CvUnitAccel *unit,
1429 SYMS_SymbolID id){
1430 // setup accel
1431 SYMS_MsfAccel *msf = dbg->msf;
1432
1433 // read id
1434 SYMS_MsfRange range = syms_msf_range_from_sn(msf, unit->sn);
1435 SYMS_CvStub *stub = syms_cv_stub_from_unit_off(unit, SYMS_ID_u32_1(id));
1436
1437 // type uid
1438 SYMS_UnitID type_uid = dbg->type_uid;
1439
1440 // zero clear result
1441 SYMS_USID result = {0};
1442
1443 // parse symbol
1444 if (stub != 0){
1445 SYMS_CvElement element = syms_cv_element(data, msf, range, stub->off, 1);
1446 switch (element.kind){
1447 default:break;
1448
1449 case SYMS_CvSymKind_LDATA32:
1450 case SYMS_CvSymKind_GDATA32:
1451 {
1452 SYMS_CvData32 data32 = {0};
1453 syms_msf_read_struct_in_range(data, msf, element.range, 0, &data32);
1454
1455 result.uid = type_uid;
1456 result.sid = SYMS_ID_u32_u32(SYMS_CvSymbolIDKind_Index, data32.itype);
1457 }break;
1458
1459 case SYMS_CvSymKind_LOCAL:
1460 {
1461 SYMS_CvLocal loc = {0};
1462 syms_msf_read_struct_in_range(data, msf, element.range, 0, &loc);
1463
1464 result.uid = type_uid;
1465 result.sid = SYMS_ID_u32_u32(SYMS_CvSymbolIDKind_Index, loc.itype);
1466 }break;
1467
1468 case SYMS_CvSymKind_REGREL32:
1469 {
1470 SYMS_CvRegrel32 regrel32 = {0};
1471 syms_msf_read_struct_in_range(data, msf, element.range, 0, &regrel32);
1472
1473 result.uid = type_uid;
1474 result.sid = SYMS_ID_u32_u32(SYMS_CvSymbolIDKind_Index, regrel32.itype);
1475 }break;
1476
1477 case SYMS_CvSymKind_LTHREAD32:
1478 case SYMS_CvSymKind_GTHREAD32:
1479 {
1480 SYMS_CvThread32 thread32 = {0};
1481 syms_msf_read_struct_in_range(data, msf, element.range, 0, &thread32);
1482
1483 result.uid = type_uid;
1484 result.sid = SYMS_ID_u32_u32(SYMS_CvSymbolIDKind_Index, thread32.itype);
1485 }break;
1486 }
1487 }
1488
1489 return(result);
1490}

1566SYMS_API SYMS_RegSection
1567syms_pdb_reg_section_from_framepointer(SYMS_String8 data, SYMS_PdbDbgAccel *dbg,
1568 SYMS_MsfRange range, SYMS_CvStub *framepointer_stub){
1569 //- get accelerator
1570 SYMS_MsfAccel *msf = dbg->msf;
1571
1572 //- get LOCAL
1573 SYMS_CvStub *local_stub = framepointer_stub->parent;
1574 SYMS_CvElement local_element = {0};
1575 SYMS_B32 got_local = syms_false;
1576 if (local_stub != 0){
1577 local_element = syms_cv_element(data, msf, range, local_stub->off, 1);
1578 if (local_element.kind == SYMS_CvSymKind_LOCAL){
1579 got_local = syms_true;
1580 }
1581 }
1582
1583 //- get *PROC32
1584 SYMS_CvElement root_element = {0};
1585 if (got_local){
1586 SYMS_CvStub *root_stub = local_stub->parent;
1587 for (;root_stub->parent != 0;){
1588 root_stub = root_stub->parent;
1589 }
1590 root_element = syms_cv_element(data, msf, range, root_stub->off, 1);
1591 }
1592 SYMS_B32 got_proc32 = (root_element.kind == SYMS_CvSymKind_LPROC32 ||
1593 root_element.kind == SYMS_CvSymKind_GPROC32);
1594
1595 //- get FRAMEPROC
1596 SYMS_B32 got_fp_flags = syms_false;
1597 SYMS_CvFrameprocFlags fp_flags = 0;
1598 if (got_proc32){
1599 SYMS_U64 fp_off = root_element.range.off + root_element.range.size;
1600 SYMS_CvElement fp_element = syms_cv_element(data, msf, range, fp_off, 1);
1601 if (fp_element.kind == SYMS_CvSymKind_FRAMEPROC){
1602 SYMS_U64 flags_off = SYMS_MEMBER_OFFSET(SYMS_CvFrameproc, flags);
1603 got_fp_flags = syms_msf_read_struct_in_range(data, msf, fp_element.range,
1604 flags_off, &fp_flags);
1605 }
1606 }
1607
1608 //- determine the register
1609 SYMS_RegSection result = {0};
1610 SYMS_Arch arch = syms_pdb_arch_from_dbg(dbg);
1611 if (got_fp_flags){
1612 // check if parameter
1613 SYMS_U64 flags_off = SYMS_MEMBER_OFFSET(SYMS_CvLocal, flags);
1614 SYMS_CvLocalFlags local_flags = 0;
1615 syms_msf_read_struct_in_range(data, msf, local_element.range, flags_off, &local_flags);
1616 SYMS_B32 is_parameter = (local_flags & SYMS_CvLocalFlag_PARAM);
1617
1618 // get frame pointer code
1619 SYMS_CvEncodedFramePtrReg frame_ptr_reg = 0;
1620 if (is_parameter){
1621 frame_ptr_reg = SYMS_CvFrameprocFlags_Extract_ParamBasePointer(fp_flags);
1622 }
1623 else{
1624 frame_ptr_reg = SYMS_CvFrameprocFlags_Extract_LocalBasePointer(fp_flags);
1625 }
1626
1627 // get register section
1628 switch (arch){
1629 case SYMS_Arch_X86:
1630 {
1631 switch (frame_ptr_reg){
1632 case SYMS_CvEncodedFramePtrReg_StackPtr:
1633 {
1634 // TODO(allen): support SYMS_CvAllReg_VFRAME
1635 }break;
1636 case SYMS_CvEncodedFramePtrReg_FramePtr:
1637 {
1638 result = syms_pdb_reg_section_from_x86_reg(SYMS_CvRegx86_EBP);
1639 }break;
1640 case SYMS_CvEncodedFramePtrReg_BasePtr:
1641 {
1642 result = syms_pdb_reg_section_from_x86_reg(SYMS_CvRegx86_EBX);
1643 }break;
1644 }
1645 }break;
1646 case SYMS_Arch_X64:
1647 {
1648 switch (frame_ptr_reg){
1649 case SYMS_CvEncodedFramePtrReg_StackPtr:
1650 {
1651 result = syms_pdb_reg_section_from_x64_reg(SYMS_CvRegx64_RSP);
1652 }break;
1653 case SYMS_CvEncodedFramePtrReg_FramePtr:
1654 {
1655 result = syms_pdb_reg_section_from_x64_reg(SYMS_CvRegx64_RBP);
1656 }break;
1657 case SYMS_CvEncodedFramePtrReg_BasePtr:
1658 {
1659 result = syms_pdb_reg_section_from_x64_reg(SYMS_CvRegx64_R13);
1660 }break;
1661 }
1662 }break;
1663 }
1664 }
1665
1666 //- fallback
1667 else{
1668 switch (arch){
1669 case SYMS_Arch_X86:
1670 {
1671 result = syms_reg_section_X86[SYMS_RegX86Code_ebp];
1672 }break;
1673 case SYMS_Arch_X64:
1674 {
1675 result = syms_reg_section_X64[SYMS_RegX64Code_rbp];
1676 }break;
1677 }
1678 }
1679
1680 return(result);
1681}

1703SYMS_API SYMS_Location
1704syms_pdb_location_from_var_sid(SYMS_Arena *arena, SYMS_String8 data, SYMS_PdbDbgAccel *dbg,
1705 SYMS_CvUnitAccel *unit, SYMS_SymbolID sid){
1706 SYMS_Location result = {0};
1707 if (!unit->leaf_set){
1708 // setup accel
1709 SYMS_MsfAccel *msf = dbg->msf;
1710
1711 // read id
1712 SYMS_MsfRange range = syms_msf_range_from_sn(msf, unit->sn);
1713 SYMS_CvStub *stub = syms_cv_stub_from_unit_off(unit, SYMS_ID_u32_1(sid));

1715 // parse symbol
1716 if (stub != 0){
1717 SYMS_CvElement element = syms_cv_element(data, msf, range, stub->off, 1);
1718
1719 switch (element.kind){
1720 case SYMS_CvSymKind_LDATA32:
1721 case SYMS_CvSymKind_GDATA32:
1722 {
1723 SYMS_CvData32 data32 = {0};
1724 syms_msf_read_struct_in_range(data, msf, element.range, 0, &data32);
1725 SYMS_U64 section_voff = syms_pdb_voff_from_section_n(dbg, data32.sec);
1726 SYMS_U32 voff = section_voff + data32.sec_off;
1727
1728 //- build the location info for addr:`module base + off`
1729 SYMS_EvalOpList list = {0};
1730 syms_eval_op_push(arena, &list, SYMS_EvalOp_ModuleOff, syms_eval_op_params(voff));
1731
1732 result.op_list = list;
1733 result.mode = SYMS_EvalMode_Address;
1734 }break;
1735
1736 case SYMS_CvSymKind_REGREL32:
1737 {
1738 //- extract frameproc's frame size
1739 SYMS_U32 frame_size = 0;
1740 {
1741 // find containing procedure
1742 SYMS_CvStub *containing_proc = 0;
1743 for (SYMS_CvStub *node = stub->parent;
1744 node != 0;
1745 node = node->parent){
1746 SYMS_CvElement el = syms_cv_element(data, msf, range, node->off, 1);
1747 if (el.kind == SYMS_CvSymKind_LPROC32 ||
1748 el.kind == SYMS_CvSymKind_GPROC32){
1749 containing_proc = node;
1750 break;
1751 }
1752 }
1753
1754 // find frameproc symbol inside this procedure
1755 if (containing_proc != 0){
1756 for (SYMS_CvStub *node = containing_proc->first;
1757 node != 0;
1758 node = node->sibling_next){
1759 SYMS_CvElement el = syms_cv_element(data, msf, range, node->off, 1);
1760 if (el.kind == SYMS_CvSymKind_FRAMEPROC){
1761 syms_msf_read_struct_in_range(data, msf, el.range, 0, &frame_size);
1762 break;
1763 }
1764 }
1765 }
1766 }
1767
1768 //- extract regrel's info
1769 SYMS_CvRegrel32 regrel32 = {0};
1770 syms_msf_read_struct_in_range(data, msf, element.range, 0, &regrel32);
1771
1772 SYMS_CvReg cv_reg = regrel32.reg;
1773 SYMS_U32 off = regrel32.reg_off;
1774 SYMS_Arch arch = syms_pdb_arch_from_dbg(dbg);
1775 // TODO(allen): report unimplemented architecture, unimplemented register conversion
1776 SYMS_RegSection sec = syms_pdb_reg_section_from_arch_reg(arch, cv_reg);
1777
1778 //- determine if this is a stack register relative
1779 SYMS_B32 stack_reg = ((arch == SYMS_Arch_X64 && cv_reg == SYMS_CvReg_X64_RSP) ||
1780 (arch == SYMS_Arch_X86 && cv_reg == SYMS_CvReg_X86_ESP));
1781
1782 //- determine if this is a parameter
1783 SYMS_B32 is_param = (stack_reg && off > frame_size);
1784
1785 //- build the location info addr:`reg + off`
1786 SYMS_EvalOpList list = {0};
1787 syms_eval_op_push(arena, &list, SYMS_EvalOp_RegRead, syms_eval_op_params_2u16(sec.off, sec.size));
1788 if (off != 0){
1789 syms_eval_op_encode_u(arena, &list, off);
1790 syms_eval_op_push(arena, &list, SYMS_EvalOp_Add, syms_eval_op_params(SYMS_EvalTypeGroup_U));
1791 }
1792
1793 result.op_list = list;
1794 result.mode = SYMS_EvalMode_Address;
1795 result.is_parameter = is_param;
1796 }break;
1797
1798 case SYMS_CvSymKind_GTHREAD32:
1799 case SYMS_CvSymKind_LTHREAD32:
1800 {
1801 SYMS_CvThread32 thread32 = {0};
1802 syms_msf_read_struct_in_range(data, msf, element.range, 0, &thread32);
1803
1804 //- build the location info for addr:`TLS base + off`
1805 SYMS_EvalOpList list = {0};
1806 if (thread32.tls_off <= 0xFFFF){
1807 syms_eval_op_push(arena, &list, SYMS_EvalOp_TLSOff, syms_eval_op_params(thread32.tls_off));
1808 }
1809 else{
1810 syms_eval_op_push(arena, &list, SYMS_EvalOp_TLSOff, syms_eval_op_params(0xFFFF));
1811 syms_eval_op_encode_u(arena, &list, (thread32.tls_off - 0xFFFF));
1812 syms_eval_op_push(arena, &list, SYMS_EvalOp_Add, syms_eval_op_params(SYMS_EvalTypeGroup_U));
1813 }
1814
1815 result.op_list = list;
1816 result.mode = SYMS_EvalMode_Address;
1817 }break;
1818 }
1819 }
1820 }
1821 return(result);
1822}
1823
1824SYMS_API SYMS_LocRangeArray
1825syms_pdb_location_ranges_from_var_sid(SYMS_Arena *arena, SYMS_String8 data, SYMS_PdbDbgAccel *dbg,
1826 SYMS_CvUnitAccel *unit, SYMS_SymbolID sid){
1827 SYMS_LocRangeArray result = {0};
1828 if (!unit->leaf_set){
1829 //- setup accel
1830 SYMS_MsfAccel *msf = dbg->msf;
1831
1832 //- read id
1833 SYMS_MsfRange range = syms_msf_range_from_sn(msf, unit->sn);
1834 SYMS_CvStub *stub = syms_cv_stub_from_unit_off(unit, SYMS_ID_u32_1(sid));
1835
1836 //- parse symbol
1837 if (stub != 0){
1838 SYMS_CvElement element = syms_cv_element(data, msf, range, stub->off, 1);
1839 if (element.kind == SYMS_CvSymKind_LOCAL){
1840 SYMS_ArenaTemp scratch = syms_get_scratch(&arena, 1);
1841
1842 //- gather ranges
1843 SYMS_LocRangeList list = {0};
1844 for (SYMS_CvStub *child = stub->first;
1845 child != 0;
1846 child = child->sibling_next){
1847 SYMS_CvElement child_element = syms_cv_element(data, msf, range, child->off, 1);
1848 SYMS_LocID loc_id = SYMS_ID_u32_u32(SYMS_CvSymbolIDKind_Off, child->off);
1849
1850 //- determine handling path
1851 SYMS_B32 do_standard_range = syms_true;
1852 SYMS_U64 range_off = 0;
1853 switch (child_element.kind){
1854 case SYMS_CvSymKind_DEFRANGE_2005:
1855 case SYMS_CvSymKind_DEFRANGE2_2005:
1856 {
1857 // TODO(allen): Investigate these cases further
1858 do_standard_range = syms_false;
1859 }break;
1860
1861 case SYMS_CvSymKind_DEFRANGE:
1862 {
1863 range_off = SYMS_MEMBER_OFFSET(SYMS_CvDefrange, range);
1864 }break;
1865
1866 case SYMS_CvSymKind_DEFRANGE_SUBFIELD:
1867 {
1868 range_off = SYMS_MEMBER_OFFSET(SYMS_CvDefrangeSubfield, range);
1869 }break;
1870
1871 case SYMS_CvSymKind_DEFRANGE_REGISTER:
1872 {
1873 range_off = SYMS_MEMBER_OFFSET(SYMS_CvDefrangeRegister, range);
1874 }break;
1875
1876 case SYMS_CvSymKind_DEFRANGE_FRAMEPOINTER_REL:
1877 {
1878 range_off = SYMS_MEMBER_OFFSET(SYMS_CvDefrangeFramepointerRel, range);
1879 }break;
1880
1881 case SYMS_CvSymKind_DEFRANGE_SUBFIELD_REGISTER:
1882 {
1883 range_off = SYMS_MEMBER_OFFSET(SYMS_CvDefrangeSubfieldRegister, range);
1884 }break;
1885
1886 case SYMS_CvSymKind_DEFRANGE_FRAMEPOINTER_REL_FULL_SCOPE:
1887 {
1888 do_standard_range = syms_false;
1889
1890 //- emit a single range that covers all U64
1891 SYMS_LocRangeNode *node = syms_push_array(scratch.arena, SYMS_LocRangeNode, 1);
1892 SYMS_QueuePush(list.first, list.last, node);
1893 list.count += 1;
1894 node->loc_range.vrange.min = 0;
1895 node->loc_range.vrange.max = SYMS_U64_MAX;
1896 node->loc_range.loc_id = loc_id;
1897 }break;
1898
1899 case SYMS_CvSymKind_DEFRANGE_REGISTER_REL:
1900 {
1901 range_off = SYMS_MEMBER_OFFSET(SYMS_CvDefrangeRegisterRel, range);
1902 }break;
1903 }
1904
1905 //- apply range handling
1906 if (do_standard_range){
1907 SYMS_CvLvarAddrRange addr_range = {0};
1908 if (syms_msf_read_struct_in_range(data, msf, child_element.range, range_off, &addr_range)){
1909 // setup main range
1910 SYMS_U64 section_voff = syms_pdb_voff_from_section_n(dbg, addr_range.sec);
1911 SYMS_U64 vaddr_base = section_voff + addr_range.off;
1912 SYMS_U64 vaddr_last = vaddr_base + addr_range.len;
1913
1914 // setup gaps
1915 SYMS_U64 gap_off = range_off + sizeof(addr_range);
1916 SYMS_U64 gap_count = (child_element.range.size - gap_off)/sizeof(SYMS_CvLvarAddrGap);
1917 SYMS_U64 gap_opl = gap_off + gap_count*sizeof(SYMS_CvLvarAddrGap);
1918
1919 // emit loop
1920 SYMS_U64 vaddr_cursor = vaddr_base;
1921 for (SYMS_U64 gap_cursor = gap_off;
1922 gap_cursor < gap_opl;
1923 gap_cursor += sizeof(SYMS_CvLvarAddrGap)){
1924 SYMS_CvLvarAddrGap gap = {0};
1925 syms_msf_read_struct_in_range(data, msf, child_element.range, gap_off, &gap);
1926
1927 SYMS_U64 gap_first = vaddr_base + gap.off;
1928
1929 // emit range
1930 {
1931 SYMS_LocRangeNode *node = syms_push_array(scratch.arena, SYMS_LocRangeNode, 1);
1932 SYMS_QueuePush(list.first, list.last, node);
1933 list.count += 1;
1934 node->loc_range.vrange.min = vaddr_cursor;
1935 node->loc_range.vrange.max = gap_first;
1936 node->loc_range.loc_id = loc_id;
1937 }
1938
1939 // advance vaddr cursor
1940 vaddr_cursor = gap_first + gap.len;
1941 }
1942
1943 // emit range
1944 {
1945 SYMS_LocRangeNode *node = syms_push_array(scratch.arena, SYMS_LocRangeNode, 1);
1946 SYMS_QueuePush(list.first, list.last, node);
1947 list.count += 1;
1948 node->loc_range.vrange.min = vaddr_cursor;
1949 node->loc_range.vrange.max = vaddr_last;
1950 node->loc_range.loc_id = loc_id;
1951 }
1952 }
1953 }
1954 }
1955
1956 //- flatten list
1957 SYMS_LocRange *loc_ranges = syms_push_array(arena, SYMS_LocRange, list.count);
1958 SYMS_LocRange *loc_range_ptr = loc_ranges;
1959 for (SYMS_LocRangeNode *node = list.first;
1960 node != 0;
1961 node = node->next, loc_range_ptr += 1){
1962 syms_memmove(loc_range_ptr, &node->loc_range, sizeof(node->loc_range));
1963 }
1964
1965 //- fill result
1966 result.loc_ranges = loc_ranges;
1967 result.count = list.count;
1968
1969 syms_release_scratch(scratch);
1970 }
1971 }
1972 }
1973 return(result);
1974}

1976SYMS_API SYMS_Location
1977syms_pdb_location_from_id(SYMS_Arena *arena, SYMS_String8 data, SYMS_PdbDbgAccel *dbg,
1978 SYMS_CvUnitAccel *unit, SYMS_LocID loc_id){
1979 SYMS_Location result = {0};
1980 if (!unit->leaf_set){
1981 // setup accel
1982 SYMS_MsfAccel *msf = dbg->msf;
1983
1984 // read id
1985 SYMS_MsfRange range = syms_msf_range_from_sn(msf, unit->sn);
1986 SYMS_CvStub *stub = syms_cv_stub_from_unit_off(unit, SYMS_ID_u32_1(loc_id));
1987
1988 // parse symbol
1989 if (stub != 0){
1990
1991 // determine if this location is part of a parameter variable
1992 SYMS_B32 is_param = syms_false;
1993 {
1994 SYMS_CvStub *parent = stub->parent;
1995 if (parent != 0){
1996 SYMS_CvElement el = syms_cv_element(data, msf, range, parent->off, 1);
1997 if (el.kind == SYMS_CvSymKind_LOCAL){
1998 SYMS_CvLocal slocal = {0};
1999 syms_msf_read_struct_in_range(data, msf, el.range, 0, &slocal);
2000 if (slocal.flags & SYMS_CvLocalFlag_PARAM){
2001 is_param = syms_true;
2002 }
2003 }
2004 }
2005 }
2006 result.is_parameter = is_param;
2007
2008 // construct location from this symbol
2009 SYMS_CvElement element = syms_cv_element(data, msf, range, stub->off, 1);
2010
2011 switch (element.kind){
2012 case SYMS_CvSymKind_DEFRANGE_2005:
2013 case SYMS_CvSymKind_DEFRANGE2_2005:
2014 {
2015 // TODO(allen): No known cases; Don't know how to interpret
2016 }break;
2017
2018 case SYMS_CvSymKind_DEFRANGE:
2019 {
2020 // TODO(allen): No known cases; SYMS_CvDefrange 'program' - don't know how to interpret
2021 }break;
2022
2023 case SYMS_CvSymKind_DEFRANGE_SUBFIELD:
2024 {
2025 // TODO(allen): No known cases; SYMS_CvDefrangeSubfield 'program' - don't know how to interpret
2026 // TODO(allen): SYMS_CvDefrangeSubfield 'off_in_parent' - not a supported concept
2027 }break;
2028
2029 case SYMS_CvSymKind_DEFRANGE_REGISTER:
2030 {
2031 // extract info
2032 SYMS_CvDefrangeRegister defrange_register = {0};
2033 syms_msf_read_struct_in_range(data, msf, element.range, 0, &defrange_register);
2034
2035 SYMS_CvReg cv_reg = defrange_register.reg;
2036 SYMS_Arch arch = syms_pdb_arch_from_dbg(dbg);
2037 SYMS_RegSection sec = syms_pdb_reg_section_from_arch_reg(arch, cv_reg);
2038
2039 // location info ops
2040 SYMS_EvalOpList list = {0};
2041 syms_eval_op_encode_reg_section(arena, &list, sec);
2042
2043 // fill result
2044 result.op_list = list;
2045 result.mode = SYMS_EvalMode_Register;
2046 }break;
2047
2048 case SYMS_CvSymKind_DEFRANGE_FRAMEPOINTER_REL:
2049 case SYMS_CvSymKind_DEFRANGE_FRAMEPOINTER_REL_FULL_SCOPE:
2050 {
2051 // extract framepointer register
2052 SYMS_RegSection sec = syms_pdb_reg_section_from_framepointer(data, dbg, range, stub);
2053
2054 // extract offset
2055 SYMS_U32 offset = 0;
2056 syms_msf_read_struct_in_range(data, msf, element.range, 0, &offset);
2057
2058 // location info ops
2059 SYMS_EvalOpList list = {0};
2060 syms_eval_op_push(arena, &list, SYMS_EvalOp_RegRead, syms_eval_op_params_2u16(sec.off, sec.size));
2061 if (offset != 0){
2062 syms_eval_op_encode_u(arena, &list, offset);
2063 syms_eval_op_push(arena, &list, SYMS_EvalOp_Add, syms_eval_op_params(SYMS_EvalTypeGroup_U));
2064 }
2065
2066 // fill result
2067 result.op_list = list;
2068 result.mode = SYMS_EvalMode_Address;
2069 }break;
2070
2071 case SYMS_CvSymKind_DEFRANGE_SUBFIELD_REGISTER:
2072 {
2073 // TODO(allen): SYMS_CvDefrangeSubfieldRegister 'off_in_parent' - not a supported concept
2074 }break;
2075
2076 case SYMS_CvSymKind_DEFRANGE_REGISTER_REL:
2077 {
2078 // extract info
2079 SYMS_CvDefrangeRegisterRel defrange_register_rel = {0};
2080 syms_msf_read_struct_in_range(data, msf, element.range, 0, &defrange_register_rel);
2081
2082 SYMS_CvReg cv_reg = defrange_register_rel.reg;
2083 SYMS_U32 off = defrange_register_rel.reg_off;
2084 SYMS_Arch arch = syms_pdb_arch_from_dbg(dbg);
2085 SYMS_RegSection sec = syms_pdb_reg_section_from_arch_reg(arch, cv_reg);
2086
2087 // location info ops
2088 SYMS_EvalOpList list = {0};
2089 syms_eval_op_push(arena, &list, SYMS_EvalOp_RegRead, syms_eval_op_params_2u16(sec.off, sec.size));
2090 if (off != 0){
2091 syms_eval_op_encode_u(arena, &list, off);
2092 syms_eval_op_push(arena, &list, SYMS_EvalOp_Add, syms_eval_op_params(SYMS_EvalTypeGroup_U));
2093 }
2094
2095 // fill result
2096 result.op_list = list;
2097 result.mode = SYMS_EvalMode_Address;;
2098 }break;
2099 }
2100
2101 }
2102 }
2103 return(result);
2104}

2108//~ allen: PDB Member Info
2109
2110// cv parse
2111
2112SYMS_API void
2113syms_pdb__field_list_parse(SYMS_Arena *arena, SYMS_String8 data, SYMS_MsfAccel *msf,
2114 SYMS_CvUnitAccel *unit, SYMS_U32 index, SYMS_PdbMemStubList *out){
2115 // get field list from ti
2116 SYMS_CvStub *list_stub = syms_cv_stub_from_unit_index(unit, index);
2117
2118 // parse loop
2119 if (list_stub != 0){
2120 // leaf range
2121 SYMS_MsfRange range = syms_msf_range_from_sn(msf, unit->sn);
2122
2123 // use the stubs from initial parse
2124 for (SYMS_CvStub *field_stub = list_stub->first;
2125 field_stub != 0;
2126 field_stub = field_stub->sibling_next){
2127 // read kind
2128 SYMS_U32 lf_off = field_stub->off;
2129 SYMS_CvLeaf lf_kind = 0;
2130 syms_msf_read_struct_in_range(data, msf, range, lf_off, &lf_kind);
2131
2132 // recurse into indexes
2133 if (lf_kind == SYMS_CvLeaf_INDEX){
2134 // TODO(allen): infinite recursion breaker.
2135 SYMS_CvLeafIndex index = {0};
2136 if (syms_msf_read_struct_in_range(data, msf, range, lf_off, &index)){
2137 syms_pdb__field_list_parse(arena, data, msf, unit, index.itype, out);
2138 }
2139 }
2140
2141 // gather members
2142 else{
2143 switch (lf_kind){
2144 case SYMS_CvLeaf_MEMBER:
2145 case SYMS_CvLeaf_STMEMBER:
2146 case SYMS_CvLeaf_ONEMETHOD:
2147 case SYMS_CvLeaf_NESTTYPE:
2148 case SYMS_CvLeaf_NESTTYPEEX:
2149 case SYMS_CvLeaf_BCLASS:
2150 case SYMS_CvLeaf_VBCLASS:
2151 case SYMS_CvLeaf_IVBCLASS:
2152 case SYMS_CvLeaf_VFUNCTAB:
2153 case SYMS_CvLeaf_VFUNCOFF:
2154 {
2155 SYMS_CvMemStubNode *node = syms_push_array(arena, SYMS_CvMemStubNode, 1);
2156 node->name = syms_push_string_copy(arena, field_stub->name);
2157 node->num = field_stub->num;
2158 node->off = field_stub->off;
2159 node->off2 = 0;
2160 SYMS_QueuePush(out->first, out->last, node);
2161 out->mem_count += 1;
2162 }break;
2163
2164 case SYMS_CvLeaf_METHOD:
2165 {
2166 SYMS_U32 off = field_stub->off;
2167 // TODO(allen): do we get anything useful from this num?
2168 SYMS_U32 num = field_stub->num;
2169 SYMS_String8 name = syms_push_string_copy(arena, field_stub->name);
2170
2171 SYMS_U32 method_off = lf_off + sizeof(lf_kind);
2172 SYMS_CvLeafMethod method = {0};
2173 syms_msf_read_struct_in_range(data, msf, range, method_off, &method);
2174
2175 SYMS_CvStub *method_list_stub = syms_cv_stub_from_unit_index(unit, method.itype_list);
2176
2177 if (method_list_stub != 0){
2178 SYMS_U32 method_list_off = method_list_stub->off;
2179 SYMS_CvStub *method_stub = method_list_stub->first;
2180 for (SYMS_U32 i = 0;
2181 i < method.count && method_stub != 0;
2182 i += 1, method_stub = method_stub->sibling_next){
2183 SYMS_CvMemStubNode *node = syms_push_array(arena, SYMS_CvMemStubNode, 1);
2184 node->name = name;
2185 node->num = num;
2186 node->off = off;
2187 node->off2 = method_stub->off - method_list_off;
2188 SYMS_QueuePush(out->first, out->last, node);
2189 out->mem_count += 1;
2190 }
2191 }
2192 }break;
2193 }
2194 }
2195 }
2196 }
2197}
2198
2199// main api
2200
2201SYMS_API SYMS_CvMemsAccel*
2202syms_pdb_mems_accel_from_sid(SYMS_Arena *arena, SYMS_String8 data, SYMS_PdbDbgAccel *dbg,
2203 SYMS_CvUnitAccel *unit, SYMS_SymbolID id){
2204 // setup accels
2205 SYMS_MsfAccel *msf = dbg->msf;
2206
2207 // dispatch to leaf
2208 SYMS_CvMemsAccel *result = (SYMS_CvMemsAccel*)&syms_format_nil;
2209 if (unit->leaf_set){
2210
2211 // read id
2212 SYMS_CvStub *stub = 0;
2213 if (SYMS_ID_u32_0(id) == SYMS_CvSymbolIDKind_Index){
2214 stub = syms_cv_stub_from_unit_index(unit, SYMS_ID_u32_1(id));
2215 }
2216
2217 // extract field list from stub
2218 SYMS_CvTypeIndex ti = 0;
2219 if (stub != 0){
2220 SYMS_MsfRange range = syms_msf_range_from_sn(msf, unit->sn);
2221 SYMS_CvElement element = syms_cv_element(data, msf, range, stub->off, 1);
2222 switch (element.kind){
2223 case SYMS_CvLeaf_CLASS:
2224 case SYMS_CvLeaf_STRUCTURE:
2225 case SYMS_CvLeaf_INTERFACE:
2226 {
2227 SYMS_CvLeafStruct struct_ = {0};
2228 if (syms_msf_read_struct_in_range(data, msf, element.range, 0, &struct_)){
2229 ti = struct_.field;
2230 }
2231 }break;
2232
2233 case SYMS_CvLeaf_UNION:
2234 {
2235 SYMS_CvLeafUnion union_ = {0};
2236 if (syms_msf_read_struct_in_range(data, msf, element.range, 0, &union_)){
2237 ti = union_.field;
2238 }
2239 }break;
2240
2241 case SYMS_CvLeaf_CLASSPTR:
2242 case SYMS_CvLeaf_CLASSPTR2:
2243 {
2244 SYMS_CvLeafClassPtr class_ptr = {0};
2245 if (syms_msf_read_struct_in_range(data, msf, element.range, 0, &class_ptr)){
2246 ti = class_ptr.field;
2247 }
2248 }break;
2249 }
2250 }
2251
2252 if (ti != 0){
2253 // recursively gather members
2254 SYMS_PdbMemStubList list = {0};
2255 syms_pdb__field_list_parse(arena, data, msf, unit, ti, &list);
2256
2257 // construct result
2258 SYMS_String8 type_name = syms_push_string_copy(arena, stub->name);
2259 SYMS_CvMemStubNode **members = syms_push_array(arena, SYMS_CvMemStubNode*, list.mem_count);
2260 {
2261 SYMS_U64 i = 0;
2262 for (SYMS_CvMemStubNode *node = list.first;
2263 node != 0;
2264 node = node->next, i += 1){
2265 members[i] = node;
2266 }
2267 }
2268
2269 result = syms_push_array(arena, SYMS_CvMemsAccel, 1);
2270 syms_memzero_struct(result);
2271 result->format = SYMS_FileFormat_PDB;
2272 result->type_name = type_name;
2273 result->count = list.mem_count;
2274 result->members = members;
2275 }
2276 }
2277
2278 return(result);
2279}

2287SYMS_API void
2288syms_pdb__fill_method_mem_info(SYMS_String8 data, SYMS_MsfAccel *msf, SYMS_MsfRange range, SYMS_U32 vbaseoff_off,
2289 SYMS_CvFieldAttribs attribs, SYMS_String8 type_name, SYMS_String8 name,
2290 SYMS_MemInfo *out){
2291 SYMS_CvMemberAccess access = SYMS_CvFieldAttribs_Extract_ACCESS(attribs);
2292 SYMS_MemVisibility visibility = syms_mem_visibility_from_member_access(access);
2293
2294 SYMS_U32 vbaseoff = 0;
2295 SYMS_B32 is_virtual = syms_false;
2296 SYMS_B32 is_static = syms_false;
2297
2298 SYMS_CvMethodProp mprop = SYMS_CvFieldAttribs_Extract_MPROP(attribs);
2299 switch (mprop){
2300 case SYMS_CvMethodProp_INTRO:
2301 case SYMS_CvMethodProp_PUREINTRO:
2302 {
2303 syms_msf_read_struct_in_range(data, msf, range, vbaseoff_off, &vbaseoff);
2304 }//fallthrough;
2305 case SYMS_CvMethodProp_VIRTUAL:
2306 case SYMS_CvMethodProp_PUREVIRT:
2307 {
2308 is_virtual = syms_true;
2309 }break;
2310 case SYMS_CvMethodProp_STATIC:
2311 {
2312 is_static = syms_true;
2313 }break;
2314 }
2315
2316 SYMS_MemKind kind = SYMS_MemKind_Method;
2317 if (is_static){
2318 kind = SYMS_MemKind_StaticMethod;
2319 }
2320
2321 SYMS_MemFlags flags = 0;
2322 if (is_virtual){
2323 flags |= SYMS_MemFlag_Virtual;
2324 }
2325
2326 SYMS_B32 destructor_flag = syms_false;
2327 SYMS_String8 name_destructor_skipped = name;
2328 if (name.size > 0 && name.str[0] == '~'){
2329 name_destructor_skipped.str += 1;
2330 name_destructor_skipped.size -= 1;
2331 destructor_flag = syms_true;
2332 }
2333
2334 SYMS_String8 type_name_trunc = syms_string_trunc_symbol_heuristic(type_name);
2335 SYMS_String8 name_trunc = syms_string_trunc_symbol_heuristic(name_destructor_skipped);
2336
2337 if (syms_string_match(type_name_trunc, name_trunc, 0)){
2338 if (destructor_flag){
2339 flags |= SYMS_MemFlag_Destructor;
2340 }
2341 else{
2342 flags |= SYMS_MemFlag_Constructor;
2343 }
2344 }
2345
2346 out->kind = kind;
2347 out->visibility = visibility;
2348 out->flags = flags;
2349 out->virtual_off = vbaseoff;
2350}

2352SYMS_API SYMS_MemInfo
2353syms_pdb_mem_info_from_number(SYMS_Arena *arena, SYMS_String8 data, SYMS_PdbDbgAccel *dbg,
2354 SYMS_CvUnitAccel *unit, SYMS_CvMemsAccel *mems, SYMS_U64 n){
2355 // setup accels
2356 SYMS_MsfAccel *msf = dbg->msf;
2357
2358 SYMS_MemInfo result = {SYMS_MemKind_Null};
2359 if (1 <= n && n <= mems->count){
2360 SYMS_U64 index = n - 1;
2361 SYMS_CvMemStubNode *stub = mems->members[index];
2362
2363 if (stub != 0){
2364 // read kind
2365 SYMS_U32 lf_off = stub->off;
2366 SYMS_MsfRange range = syms_msf_range_from_sn(msf, unit->sn);
2367 SYMS_CvLeaf lf_kind = 0;
2368 syms_msf_read_struct_in_range(data, msf, range, lf_off, &lf_kind);
2369
2370 SYMS_U32 data_off = lf_off + sizeof(lf_kind);
2371
2372 switch (lf_kind){
2373 default:break;
2374
2375 case SYMS_CvLeaf_MEMBER:
2376 {
2377 SYMS_CvLeafMember member = {0};
2378 syms_msf_read_struct_in_range(data, msf, range, data_off, &member);
2379
2380 SYMS_CvMemberAccess access = SYMS_CvFieldAttribs_Extract_ACCESS(member.attribs);
2381 SYMS_MemVisibility visibility = syms_mem_visibility_from_member_access(access);
2382
2383 result.kind = SYMS_MemKind_DataField;
2384 result.name = syms_push_string_copy(arena, stub->name);
2385 result.visibility = visibility;
2386 result.off = stub->num;
2387 }break;
2388
2389 case SYMS_CvLeaf_STMEMBER:
2390 {
2391 SYMS_CvLeafStMember stmember = {0};
2392 syms_msf_read_struct_in_range(data, msf, range, data_off, &stmember);
2393
2394 SYMS_CvMemberAccess access = SYMS_CvFieldAttribs_Extract_ACCESS(stmember.attribs);
2395 SYMS_MemVisibility visibility = syms_mem_visibility_from_member_access(access);
2396
2397 result.kind = SYMS_MemKind_StaticData;
2398 result.name = syms_push_string_copy(arena, stub->name);
2399 result.visibility = visibility;
2400 }break;
2401
2402 case SYMS_CvLeaf_METHOD:
2403 {
2404 SYMS_CvLeafMethod method = {0};
2405 syms_msf_read_struct_in_range(data, msf, range, data_off, &method);
2406
2407 SYMS_CvStub *method_list_stub = syms_cv_stub_from_unit_index(unit, method.itype_list);
2408
2409 if (method_list_stub != 0){
2410 SYMS_U32 rec_off = method_list_stub->off + stub->off2;
2411 SYMS_CvMethod methodrec = {0};
2412 syms_msf_read_struct_in_range(data, msf, range, rec_off, &methodrec);
2413 syms_pdb__fill_method_mem_info(data, msf, range, rec_off + sizeof(methodrec), methodrec.attribs,
2414 mems->type_name, stub->name, &result);
2415 result.name = syms_push_string_copy(arena, stub->name);
2416 }
2417 }break;
2418
2419 case SYMS_CvLeaf_ONEMETHOD:
2420 {
2421 SYMS_CvLeafOneMethod onemethod = {0};
2422 syms_msf_read_struct_in_range(data, msf, range, data_off, &onemethod);
2423
2424 syms_pdb__fill_method_mem_info(data, msf, range, data_off + sizeof(onemethod), onemethod.attribs,
2425 mems->type_name, stub->name, &result);
2426 result.name = syms_push_string_copy(arena, stub->name);
2427 }break;
2428
2429 case SYMS_CvLeaf_NESTTYPE:
2430 case SYMS_CvLeaf_NESTTYPEEX:
2431 {
2432 SYMS_MemVisibility visibility = SYMS_MemVisibility_Public;
2433 if (lf_kind == SYMS_CvLeaf_NESTTYPEEX){
2434 SYMS_CvLeafNestTypeEx nest_type_ex = {0};
2435 syms_msf_read_struct_in_range(data, msf, range, data_off, &nest_type_ex);
2436 SYMS_CvMemberAccess access = SYMS_CvFieldAttribs_Extract_ACCESS(nest_type_ex.attribs);
2437 visibility = syms_mem_visibility_from_member_access(access);
2438 }
2439
2440 result.kind = SYMS_MemKind_NestedType;
2441 result.name = syms_push_string_copy(arena, stub->name);
2442 result.visibility = visibility;
2443 }break;
2444
2445 case SYMS_CvLeaf_BCLASS:
2446 {
2447 SYMS_CvLeafBClass bclass = {0};
2448 syms_msf_read_struct_in_range(data, msf, range, data_off, &bclass);
2449
2450 SYMS_CvMemberAccess access = SYMS_CvFieldAttribs_Extract_ACCESS(bclass.attribs);
2451 SYMS_MemVisibility visibility = syms_mem_visibility_from_member_access(access);
2452
2453 result.kind = SYMS_MemKind_BaseClass;
2454 result.name = syms_push_string_copy(arena, stub->name);
2455 result.visibility = visibility;
2456 result.off = stub->num;
2457 }break;
2458
2459 case SYMS_CvLeaf_VBCLASS:
2460 case SYMS_CvLeaf_IVBCLASS:
2461 {
2462 SYMS_CvLeafVBClass vbclass = {0};
2463 syms_msf_read_struct_in_range(data, msf, range, data_off, &vbclass);
2464
2465 SYMS_CvMemberAccess access = SYMS_CvFieldAttribs_Extract_ACCESS(vbclass.attribs);
2466 SYMS_MemVisibility visibility = syms_mem_visibility_from_member_access(access);
2467
2468 result.kind = SYMS_MemKind_VBaseClassPtr;
2469 result.name = syms_push_string_copy(arena, stub->name);
2470 result.visibility = visibility;
2471 result.off = stub->num;
2472 }break;
2473
2474 case SYMS_CvLeaf_VFUNCTAB:
2475 {
2476 SYMS_CvLeafVFuncTab vfunctab = {0};
2477 syms_msf_read_struct_in_range(data, msf, range, data_off, &vfunctab);
2478
2479 result.kind = SYMS_MemKind_VTablePtr;
2480 result.off = 0;
2481 }break;
2482
2483 case SYMS_CvLeaf_VFUNCOFF:
2484 {
2485 SYMS_CvLeafVFuncOff vfuncoff = {0};
2486 syms_msf_read_struct_in_range(data, msf, range, data_off, &vfuncoff);
2487
2488 result.kind = SYMS_MemKind_VTablePtr;
2489 result.off = vfuncoff.off;
2490 }break;
2491 }
2492 }
2493 }
2494
2495 return(result);
2496}

2623SYMS_API SYMS_EnumMemberArray
2624syms_pdb_enum_member_array_from_sid(SYMS_Arena *arena, SYMS_String8 data, SYMS_PdbDbgAccel *dbg,
2625 SYMS_CvUnitAccel *unit, SYMS_SymbolID sid){
2626 // setup accels
2627 SYMS_MsfAccel *msf = dbg->msf;
2628
2629 // dispatch to leaf
2630 SYMS_EnumMemberArray result = {0};
2631 if (unit->leaf_set){
2632 SYMS_MsfRange range = syms_msf_range_from_sn(msf, unit->sn);
2633
2634 // read id
2635 SYMS_CvStub *stub = 0;
2636 if (SYMS_ID_u32_0(sid) == SYMS_CvSymbolIDKind_Index){
2637 stub = syms_cv_stub_from_unit_index(unit, SYMS_ID_u32_1(sid));
2638 }
2639
2640 // extract field list from stub
2641 SYMS_CvTypeIndex ti = 0;
2642 if (stub != 0){
2643 SYMS_CvElement element = syms_cv_element(data, msf, range, stub->off, 1);
2644 if (element.kind == SYMS_CvLeaf_ENUM){
2645 SYMS_CvLeafEnum enum_ = {0};
2646 if (syms_msf_read_struct_in_range(data, msf, element.range, 0, &enum_)){
2647 ti = enum_.field;
2648 }
2649 }
2650 }
2651
2652 // get field list from ti
2653 SYMS_CvStub *list_stub = syms_cv_stub_from_unit_index(unit, ti);
2654
2655 // parse loop
2656 if (list_stub != 0){
2657 // count the enumerates
2658 SYMS_U64 count = 0;
2659 for (SYMS_CvStub *field_stub = list_stub->first;
2660 field_stub != 0;
2661 field_stub = field_stub->sibling_next){
2662 SYMS_U32 lf_off = field_stub->off;
2663 SYMS_CvLeaf lf_kind = 0;
2664 syms_msf_read_struct_in_range(data, msf, range, lf_off, &lf_kind);
2665 if (lf_kind == SYMS_CvLeaf_ENUMERATE){
2666 count += 1;
2667 }
2668 }
2669
2670 // fill the enumerates array
2671 result.count = count;
2672 result.enum_members = syms_push_array(arena, SYMS_EnumMember, count);
2673
2674 SYMS_EnumMember *enum_mem_ptr = result.enum_members;
2675 for (SYMS_CvStub *field_stub = list_stub->first;
2676 field_stub != 0;
2677 field_stub = field_stub->sibling_next){
2678 SYMS_U32 lf_off = field_stub->off;
2679 SYMS_CvLeaf lf_kind = 0;
2680 syms_msf_read_struct_in_range(data, msf, range, lf_off, &lf_kind);
2681 if (lf_kind == SYMS_CvLeaf_ENUMERATE){
2682 enum_mem_ptr->name = syms_push_string_copy(arena, field_stub->name);
2683 enum_mem_ptr->val = field_stub->num;
2684 enum_mem_ptr += 1;
2685 }
2686 }
2687 }
2688 }
2689
2690 return(result);
2691}

2746SYMS_API SYMS_U64RangeArray

2805SYMS_API SYMS_SymbolIDArray
2806syms_pdb_scope_children_from_sid(SYMS_Arena *arena, SYMS_String8 data, SYMS_PdbDbgAccel *dbg,
2807 SYMS_CvUnitAccel *unit, SYMS_SymbolID id){
2808 // dispatch to sym or leaf
2809 SYMS_ArenaTemp scratch = syms_get_scratch(&arena, 1);
2810 SYMS_SymbolIDList list = {0};
2811 if (!unit->leaf_set){
2812 // setup accels
2813 SYMS_MsfAccel *msf = dbg->msf;
2814
2815 // read id
2816 SYMS_MsfRange range = syms_msf_range_from_sn(msf, unit->sn);
2817 SYMS_CvStub *stub = syms_cv_stub_from_unit_off(unit, SYMS_ID_u32_1(id));
2818
2819 // build list
2820 if (stub != 0){
2821 SYMS_CvElement element = syms_cv_element(data, msf, range, stub->off, 1);
2822 switch (element.kind){
2823 default:break;
2824
2825 case SYMS_CvSymKind_LPROC32_ID:
2826 case SYMS_CvSymKind_GPROC32_ID:
2827 case SYMS_CvSymKind_LPROC32:
2828 case SYMS_CvSymKind_GPROC32:
2829 case SYMS_CvSymKind_BLOCK32:
2830 {
2831 for (SYMS_CvStub *child = stub->first;
2832 child != 0;
2833 child = child->sibling_next){
2834 SYMS_SymbolIDNode *node = syms_push_array(arena, SYMS_SymbolIDNode, 1);
2835 SYMS_QueuePush(list.first, list.last, node);
2836 node->id = SYMS_ID_u32_u32(SYMS_CvSymbolIDKind_Off, child->off);
2837 list.count += 1;
2838 }
2839 }break;
2840 }
2841 }
2842 }
2843
2844 // convert list to array
2845 SYMS_SymbolIDArray result = syms_sid_array_from_list(arena, &list);
2846
2847 syms_release_scratch(scratch);
2848
2849 return(result);
2850}

2853//~ allen: PDB Signature Info
2854
2855// pdb specific helper
2856SYMS_API SYMS_SigInfo
2857syms_pdb_sig_info_from_sig_index(SYMS_Arena *arena, SYMS_String8 data, SYMS_PdbDbgAccel *dbg,
2858 SYMS_CvUnitAccel *unit, SYMS_CvTypeIndex index){
2859 SYMS_SigInfo result = {0};
2860
2861 if (unit->leaf_set){
2862 // setup accels
2863 SYMS_MsfAccel *msf = dbg->msf;
2864
2865 // get unit range
2866 SYMS_MsfRange range = syms_msf_range_from_sn(msf, unit->sn);
2867
2868 // get member function data
2869 SYMS_CvTypeIndex arg_itype = 0;
2870 SYMS_CvTypeIndex ret_itype = 0;
2871 SYMS_CvTypeIndex this_itype = 0;
2872
2873 {
2874 SYMS_CvStub *sig_stub = syms_cv_stub_from_unit_index(unit, index);
2875 if (sig_stub != 0){
2876 SYMS_CvElement sig_element = syms_cv_element(data, msf, range, sig_stub->off, 1);
2877 switch (sig_element.kind){
2878 case SYMS_CvLeaf_PROCEDURE:
2879 {
2880 SYMS_CvLeafProcedure proc = {0};
2881 syms_msf_read_struct_in_range(data, msf, sig_element.range, 0, &proc);
2882 arg_itype = proc.arg_itype;
2883 ret_itype = proc.ret_itype;
2884 }break;
2885
2886 case SYMS_CvLeaf_MFUNCTION:
2887 {
2888 SYMS_CvLeafMFunction mfunc = {0};
2889 syms_msf_read_struct_in_range(data, msf, sig_element.range, 0, &mfunc);
2890 arg_itype = mfunc.arg_itype;
2891 ret_itype = mfunc.ret_itype;
2892 this_itype = mfunc.this_itype;
2893 }break;
2894 }
2895 }
2896 }
2897
2898 // get args list
2899 SYMS_CvLeafArgList args_list = {0};
2900 SYMS_MsfRange args_list_range = {0};
2901 if (arg_itype != 0){
2902 SYMS_CvStub *args_stub = syms_cv_stub_from_unit_index(unit, arg_itype);
2903 if (args_stub != 0){
2904 SYMS_CvElement args_element = syms_cv_element(data, msf, range, args_stub->off, 1);
2905 if (args_element.kind == SYMS_CvLeaf_ARGLIST){
2906 syms_msf_read_struct_in_range(data, msf, args_element.range, 0, &args_list);
2907 args_list_range = syms_msf_sub_range(args_element.range, sizeof(args_list),
2908 args_element.range.size - sizeof(args_list));
2909 }
2910 }
2911 }
2912
2913 // build params list
2914
2915 SYMS_SymbolIDArray param_array = {0};
2916 if (args_list.count > 0){
2917 SYMS_ArenaTemp scratch = syms_get_scratch(&arena, 1);
2918 SYMS_String8 args_list_data = syms_msf_read_whole_range(scratch.arena, data, msf, args_list_range);
2919
2920 SYMS_CvTypeIndex *ti_array = (SYMS_CvTypeIndex*)args_list_data.str;
2921 SYMS_U32 data_max_count = args_list_data.size/sizeof(SYMS_CvTypeIndex);
2922 SYMS_U32 count = SYMS_ClampTop(args_list.count, data_max_count);
2923
2924 SYMS_SymbolID *ids = syms_push_array(arena, SYMS_SymbolID, count);
2925 SYMS_SymbolID *id_ptr = ids;
2926 SYMS_CvTypeIndex *ti = ti_array;
2927 for (SYMS_U32 i = 0; i < count; i += 1, ti += 1, id_ptr += 1){
2928 *id_ptr = SYMS_ID_u32_u32(SYMS_CvSymbolIDKind_Index, *ti);
2929 }
2930
2931 param_array.ids = ids;
2932 param_array.count = count;
2933 syms_release_scratch(scratch);
2934 }
2935
2936 result.uid = unit->uid;
2937 result.param_type_ids = param_array;
2938 result.return_type_id = SYMS_ID_u32_u32(SYMS_CvSymbolIDKind_Index, ret_itype);
2939 result.this_type_id = SYMS_ID_u32_u32(SYMS_CvSymbolIDKind_Index, this_itype);
2940
2941 }
2942
2943 return(result);
2944}
2945
2946// main api
2947SYMS_API SYMS_SigInfo
2948syms_pdb_sig_info_from_id(SYMS_Arena *arena, SYMS_String8 data, SYMS_PdbDbgAccel *dbg,
2949 SYMS_CvUnitAccel *unit, SYMS_SymbolID id){
2950 SYMS_SigInfo result = {0};
2951
2952 if (unit->leaf_set){
2953 // setup accels
2954 SYMS_MsfAccel *msf = dbg->msf;
2955 SYMS_MsfRange range = syms_msf_range_from_sn(msf, unit->sn);
2956
2957 // method stub symbol -> sig info
2958 if (SYMS_ID_u32_0(id) == SYMS_CvSymbolIDKind_Off){
2959 SYMS_CvStub *stub = syms_cv_stub_from_unit_off(unit, SYMS_ID_u32_1(id));
2960 if (stub != 0){
2961 SYMS_U32 lf_off = stub->off;
2962 SYMS_CvLeaf lf_kind = 0;
2963 syms_msf_read_struct_in_range(data, msf, range, lf_off, &lf_kind);
2964
2965 SYMS_U32 data_off = lf_off + sizeof(lf_kind);
2966
2967 switch (lf_kind){
2968 case SYMS_CvLeaf_METHOD:
2969 {
2970 SYMS_CvLeafMethod method = {0};
2971 syms_msf_read_struct_in_range(data, msf, range, data_off, &method);
2972
2973 SYMS_CvStub *method_list_stub = syms_cv_stub_from_unit_index(unit, method.itype_list);
2974
2975 if (method_list_stub != 0){
2976 SYMS_U32 rec_off = method_list_stub->off + SYMS_ID_u16_1(id);
2977 SYMS_CvMethod methodrec = {0};
2978 syms_msf_read_struct_in_range(data, msf, range, rec_off, &methodrec);
2979 result = syms_pdb_sig_info_from_sig_index(arena, data, dbg, unit, methodrec.itype);
2980 }
2981 }break;
2982
2983 case SYMS_CvLeaf_ONEMETHOD:
2984 {
2985 SYMS_CvLeafOneMethod onemethod = {0};
2986 syms_msf_read_struct_in_range(data, msf, range, data_off, &onemethod);
2987 result = syms_pdb_sig_info_from_sig_index(arena, data, dbg, unit, onemethod.itype);
2988 }break;
2989 }
2990 }
2991 }
2992
2993 // type symbol -> sig info
2994 else{
2995 result = syms_pdb_sig_info_from_sig_index(arena, data, dbg, unit, SYMS_ID_u32_1(id));
2996 }
2997 }
2998
2999 return(result);
3000}

3003//~ allen: PDB Line Info
3004
3005// main api
3006SYMS_API SYMS_String8
3007syms_pdb_file_name_from_id(SYMS_Arena *arena, SYMS_String8 data, SYMS_PdbDbgAccel *dbg,
3008 SYMS_PdbUnitSetAccel *unit_set, SYMS_UnitID uid, SYMS_FileID id){
3009 // setup accel
3010 SYMS_MsfAccel *msf = dbg->msf;
3011
3012 // read string
3013 SYMS_String8 result = {0};
3014 switch (SYMS_ID_u32_0(id)){
3015 case SYMS_CvFileIDKind_IPIOff:
3016 {
3017 SYMS_PdbTpiAccel *ipi = &dbg->ipi;
3018 SYMS_MsfRange ipi_range = syms_msf_range_from_sn(msf, ipi->type_sn);
3019 result = syms_msf_read_zstring_in_range(arena, data, msf, ipi_range, SYMS_ID_u32_1(id));
3020 }break;
3021
3022 case SYMS_CvFileIDKind_IPIStringID:
3023 {
3024 SYMS_PdbTpiAccel *ipi = &dbg->ipi;
3025 SYMS_MsfRange ipi_range = syms_msf_range_from_sn(msf, ipi->type_sn);
3026 SYMS_U32 src_item_off = syms_pdb_tpi_off_from_ti(data, msf, ipi, SYMS_ID_u32_1(id));
3027 SYMS_CvElement src_element = syms_cv_element(data, msf, ipi_range, src_item_off, 1);
3028 if (src_element.kind == SYMS_CvLeaf_STRING_ID){
3029 SYMS_CvLeafStringId string_id = {0};
3030 if (syms_msf_read_struct_in_range(data, msf, src_element.range, 0, &string_id)){
3031 result = syms_msf_read_zstring_in_range(arena, data, msf, src_element.range, sizeof(string_id));
3032 }
3033 }
3034 }break;
3035
3036 case SYMS_CvFileIDKind_StrTblOff:
3037 {
3038 result = syms_pdb_strtbl_string_from_off(arena, data, dbg, SYMS_ID_u32_1(id));
3039 }break;
3040
3041 case SYMS_CvFileIDKind_C11Off:
3042 {
3043 SYMS_PdbCompUnit *comp_unit = syms_pdb_comp_unit_from_id(unit_set, uid);
3044 SYMS_MsfRange c11_range = syms_pdb_msf_range_from_comp_unit(comp_unit, SYMS_PdbCompUnitRange_C11);
3045 SYMS_U32 off = SYMS_ID_u32_1(id);
3046 syms_msf_read_in_range(data, msf, c11_range, off, 1, &result.size);
3047 result.str = syms_push_array(arena, SYMS_U8, result.size);
3048 syms_msf_read_in_range(data, msf, c11_range, off + 1, result.size, result.str);
3049 }break;
3050 }
3051 return(result);
3052}
3053
3054SYMS_API SYMS_LineParseOut
3055syms_pdb_line_parse_from_uid(SYMS_Arena *arena, SYMS_String8 data, SYMS_PdbDbgAccel *dbg,
3056 SYMS_PdbUnitSetAccel *unit_set, SYMS_UnitID uid){
3057 SYMS_LineParseOut result = {0};
3058
3059 //- get comp unit
3060 SYMS_PdbCompUnit *comp_unit = syms_pdb_comp_unit_from_id(unit_set, uid);
3061 if (comp_unit != 0){
3062 SYMS_ArenaTemp scratch = syms_get_scratch(&arena, 1);
3063
3064 // build table
3065 SYMS_CvLineTableLoose loose = {0};
3066
3067 SYMS_MsfAccel *msf = dbg->msf;
3068
3069 // try C13
3070 SYMS_MsfRange c13_range = syms_pdb_msf_range_from_comp_unit(comp_unit, SYMS_PdbCompUnitRange_C13);
3071 if (c13_range.size > 0){
3072 SYMS_CvC13SubSectionList list = {0};
3073 syms_cv_c13_sub_sections_from_range(scratch.arena, data, msf, c13_range, &list);
3074 syms_cv_loose_lines_from_c13(scratch.arena, data, msf, c13_range, list.first,
3075 dbg->section_voffs, dbg->section_count, &loose);
3076 }
3077
3078 // try C11
3079 SYMS_MsfRange c11_range = syms_pdb_msf_range_from_comp_unit(comp_unit, SYMS_PdbCompUnitRange_C11);
3080 if (c11_range.size > 0){
3081 syms_cv_loose_lines_from_c11(scratch.arena, data, msf, c11_range,
3082 dbg->section_voffs, dbg->section_count, &loose);
3083 }
3084
3085 // bake line data
3086 result = syms_cv_line_parse_from_loose(arena, &loose);
3087
3088 syms_release_scratch(scratch);
3089 }
3090
3091 return(result);
3092}
