3155SYMS_API SYMS_U64
3156syms_pdb_voff_from_link_name(SYMS_String8 data, SYMS_PdbDbgAccel *dbg, SYMS_PdbLinkMapAccel *map,
3157 SYMS_CvUnitAccel *link_unit, SYMS_String8 name){
3158 SYMS_U64 result = 0;
3159
3160 // get accelerators
3161 SYMS_MsfAccel *msf = dbg->msf;
3162 SYMS_PdbGsiAccel *psi = &dbg->psi;
3163
3164 if (psi->bucket_count > 0){
3165 // get unit range
3166 SYMS_MsfRange range = syms_msf_range_from_sn(msf, link_unit->sn);
3167
3168 // grab scratch
3169 SYMS_ArenaTemp scratch = syms_get_scratch(0, 0);
3170
3171 // get bucket
3172 SYMS_U32 name_hash = syms_pdb_hashV1(name);
3173 SYMS_U32 bucket_index = name_hash%psi->bucket_count;
3174
3175 // iterate bucket
3176 for (SYMS_PdbChain *bucket = psi->buckets[bucket_index];
3177 bucket != 0;
3178 bucket = bucket->next){
3179 SYMS_U32 off = bucket->v;
3180 SYMS_CvStub *stub = syms_cv_stub_from_unit_off(link_unit, off);
3181 if (stub != 0 && syms_string_match(stub->name, name, 0)){
3182 SYMS_CvElement element = syms_cv_element(data, msf, range, stub->off, 1);
3183 if (element.kind == SYMS_CvSymKind_PUB32){
3184 SYMS_CvPubsym32 pub = {0};
3185 syms_msf_read_struct_in_range(data, msf, element.range, 0, &pub);
3186 SYMS_U64 section_voff = syms_pdb_voff_from_section_n(dbg, pub.sec);
3187 result = section_voff + pub.off;
3188 break;
3189 }
3190 }
3191 }
3192
3193 // release scratch
3194 syms_release_scratch(scratch);
3195 }
3196
3197 return(result);
3198}
3199
3200SYMS_API SYMS_LinkNameRecArray
3201syms_pdb_link_name_array_from_unit(SYMS_Arena *arena, SYMS_String8 data,
3202 SYMS_PdbDbgAccel *dbg, SYMS_CvUnitAccel *unit){
3203 SYMS_LinkNameRecArray result = {0};
3204
3205 if (unit->pub_count != 0){
3206 // setup accels
3207 SYMS_MsfAccel *msf = dbg->msf;
3208
3209 // allocate output memory
3210 SYMS_U64 count = unit->pub_count;
3211 SYMS_LinkNameRec *rec = syms_push_array(arena, SYMS_LinkNameRec, count);
3212
3213 // fill output array
3214 SYMS_LinkNameRec *rec_ptr = rec;
3215 SYMS_CvStub **stub_opl = unit->pub_stubs + count;
3216 for (SYMS_CvStub **stub_ptr = unit->pub_stubs; stub_ptr < stub_opl; stub_ptr += 1, rec_ptr += 1){
3217 SYMS_CvStub *stub = *stub_ptr;
3218
3219 // extract rec from stub
3220 SYMS_String8 name = stub->name;
3221 SYMS_U64 voff = 0;
3222 {
3223 SYMS_MsfRange range = syms_msf_range_from_sn(msf, unit->sn);
3224 SYMS_CvElement sig_element = syms_cv_element(data, msf, range, stub->off, 1);
3225 SYMS_CvPubsym32 pubsym32 = {0};
3226 if (syms_msf_read_struct_in_range(data, msf, sig_element.range, 0, &pubsym32)){
3227 SYMS_U64 section_voff = syms_pdb_voff_from_section_n(dbg, pubsym32.sec);
3228 voff = section_voff + pubsym32.off;
3229 }
3230 }
3231
3232 // fill stripped rec
3233 rec_ptr->name = syms_push_string_copy(arena, name);
3234 rec_ptr->voff = voff;
3235 }
3236
3237 // fill result struct
3238 result.recs = rec;
3239 result.count = count;
3240 }
3241
3242 return(result);
3243}

3248SYMS_API SYMS_TypeKind
3249syms_pdb_type_kind_from_cv_pointer_mode(SYMS_CvPointerMode mode){
3250 SYMS_TypeKind result = SYMS_TypeKind_Null;
3251 switch (mode){
3252 default:break;
3253 case SYMS_CvPointerMode_PTR: result = SYMS_TypeKind_Ptr; break;
3254 case SYMS_CvPointerMode_LVREF: result = SYMS_TypeKind_LValueReference; break;
3255 case SYMS_CvPointerMode_RVREF: result = SYMS_TypeKind_RValueReference; break;
3256 case SYMS_CvPointerMode_PMEM:
3257 case SYMS_CvPointerMode_PMFUNC: result = SYMS_TypeKind_MemberPtr; break;

3259 return(result);

3262SYMS_API SYMS_TypeModifiers
3263syms_pdb_modifier_from_cv_pointer_attribs(SYMS_CvPointerAttribs attribs){
3264 SYMS_TypeModifiers result = 0;
3265 if (attribs & SYMS_CvPointerAttrib_IS_VOLATILE){
3266 result |= SYMS_TypeModifier_Volatile;
3267 }
3268 if (attribs & SYMS_CvPointerAttrib_IS_CONST){
3269 result |= SYMS_TypeModifier_Const;
3270 }
3271 if (attribs & SYMS_CvPointerAttrib_IS_UNALIGNED){
3272 result |= SYMS_TypeModifier_Packed;
3273 }
3274 if (attribs & SYMS_CvPointerAttrib_IS_RESTRICTED){
3275 result |= SYMS_TypeModifier_Restrict;
3276 }
3277 if (attribs & SYMS_CvPointerAttrib_IS_LREF){
3278 result |= SYMS_TypeModifier_Reference;
3279 }
3280 if (attribs & SYMS_CvPointerAttrib_IS_RREF){
3281 result |= SYMS_TypeModifier_RValueReference;
3282 }
3283 return(result);
3284}

3286SYMS_API SYMS_TypeModifiers
3287syms_pdb_modifier_from_cv_modifier_flags(SYMS_CvModifierFlags flags){
3288 SYMS_TypeModifiers result = 0;
3289 if (flags & SYMS_CvModifierFlag_VOLATILE){
3290 result |= SYMS_TypeModifier_Volatile;
3291 }
3292 if (flags & SYMS_CvModifierFlag_CONST){
3293 result |= SYMS_TypeModifier_Const;
3294 }
3295 if (flags & SYMS_CvModifierFlag_UNALIGNED){
3296 result |= SYMS_TypeModifier_Packed;
3297 }
3298 return(result);
3299}

3301SYMS_API SYMS_CallConvention
3302syms_pdb_call_convention_from_cv_call_kind(SYMS_CvCallKind kind){
3303 SYMS_CallConvention result = SYMS_CallConvention_NULL;
3304 switch (kind){
3305 case SYMS_CvCallKind_NEAR_C: result = SYMS_CallConvention_NEAR_C; break;
3306 case SYMS_CvCallKind_FAR_C: result = SYMS_CallConvention_FAR_C; break;
3307 case SYMS_CvCallKind_NEAR_PASCAL: result = SYMS_CallConvention_NEAR_PASCAL; break;
3308 case SYMS_CvCallKind_FAR_PASCAL: result = SYMS_CallConvention_FAR_PASCAL; break;
3309 case SYMS_CvCallKind_NEAR_FAST: result = SYMS_CallConvention_NEAR_FAST; break;
3310 case SYMS_CvCallKind_FAR_FAST: result = SYMS_CallConvention_FAR_FAST; break;
3311 case SYMS_CvCallKind_NEAR_STD: result = SYMS_CallConvention_NEAR_STD; break;
3312 case SYMS_CvCallKind_FAR_STD: result = SYMS_CallConvention_FAR_STD; break;
3313 case SYMS_CvCallKind_NEAR_SYS: result = SYMS_CallConvention_NEAR_SYS; break;
3314 case SYMS_CvCallKind_FAR_SYS: result = SYMS_CallConvention_FAR_SYS; break;
3315 case SYMS_CvCallKind_THISCALL: result = SYMS_CallConvention_THISCALL; break;
3316 case SYMS_CvCallKind_MIPSCALL: result = SYMS_CallConvention_MIPSCALL; break;
3317 case SYMS_CvCallKind_GENERIC: result = SYMS_CallConvention_GENERIC; break;
3318 case SYMS_CvCallKind_ALPHACALL: result = SYMS_CallConvention_ALPHACALL; break;
3319 case SYMS_CvCallKind_PPCCALL: result = SYMS_CallConvention_PPCCALL; break;
3320 case SYMS_CvCallKind_SHCALL: result = SYMS_CallConvention_SHCALL; break;
3321 case SYMS_CvCallKind_ARMCALL: result = SYMS_CallConvention_ARMCALL; break;
